    <style>
      :root {
        --bg-deep: #0a0b10;
        --panel-bg: rgba(12, 14, 24, 0.94);
        --panel-border: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
        --primary-glow: #22d3ee;
        --secondary-glow: #e879f9;
        --emerald-glow: #34d399;
        --amber-glow: #fbbf24;
        --crimson-glow: #fb7185;
        --accent-btn: #0891b2;
        --accent-btn-hover: #06b6d4;
        --text-primary: #f8fafc;
        --text-muted: #94a3b8;
        --font-display: 'Outfit', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
        --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      }

      body.theme-amber {
        --primary-glow: #fbbf24;
        --secondary-glow: #f43f5e;
        --panel-border: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.32);
        --accent-btn: #d97706;
        --accent-btn-hover: #f59e0b;
      }

      body.theme-emerald {
        --primary-glow: #34d399;
        --secondary-glow: #38bdf8;
        --panel-border: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.32);
        --accent-btn: #059669;
        --accent-btn-hover: #10b981;
      }

      * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-select: none;
        -webkit-touch-callout: none;
      }

      html,
      body {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        height: 100dvh;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        overscroll-behavior: none;
        background-color: var(--bg-deep);
        color: var(--text-primary);
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        touch-action: none;
      }

      #game-canvas {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        display: block;
        cursor: crosshair;
        touch-action: none;
        z-index: 1;
      }

      /* Top-anchored HUD Layer (Does not cover playable arena) */
      #hud-layer {
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        height: auto;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 10;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 10px 0 0;
        transition: opacity 0.18s ease;
      }

      body[data-state='title'] #hud-layer {
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
      }

      /* Fluid Top HUD Container (Never clips or overflows on mobile) */
      .hud-top-container {
        width: 95vw;
        max-width: 500px;
        margin: 0 auto;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 6px;
      }

      .hud-top-bar {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        grid-template-areas:
          'left right'
          'center center';
        align-items: stretch;
        gap: 6px;
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      .hud-cluster {
        background: var(--panel-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
        border-radius: 10px;
        padding: 8px 14px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      }

      .hud-left {
        grid-area: left;
        min-width: 0;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1.35fr);
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .hud-stat-block {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 2px;
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .hud-kicker {
        font-size: 9.5px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        white-space: nowrap;
        line-height: 1.1;
      }

      .hud-hero-num {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 20px;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1.05;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: var(--text-primary);
        text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.35);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .combo-value-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
      }

      .hud-divider {
        width: 1px;
        height: 28px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
      }

      .combo-pips-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 3px;
      }

      .combo-pip {
        width: 8px;
        height: 5px;
        border-radius: 2px;
        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
        transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.12s ease;
      }

      .combo-pip.active {
        background: var(--primary-glow);
        border-color: #a5f3fc;
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.7);
      }

      .combo-pip.fever {
        background: var(--secondary-glow);
        border-color: #f5d0fe;
        box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(232, 121, 249, 0.85);
      }

      .perks-badge-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 4px;
        margin-top: 2px;
        font-size: 10px;
      }

      .perk-mini-tag {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 2px;
        padding: 1px 5px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 9px;
        color: var(--primary-glow);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      /* Tier 2: Wave & Timer Bar Cluster */
      .hud-center {
        grid-area: center;
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
        padding: 7px 12px;
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
      }

      .hud-center.breather-mode {
        border-color: var(--emerald-glow);
        box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      }

      .hud-center-top {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        width: 100%;
        gap: 8px;
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .wave-title-group {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .wave-num-label {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--primary-glow);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        white-space: nowrap;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .wave-tier-label {
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }

      .hud-center.breather-mode .wave-tier-label {
        color: var(--emerald-glow);
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.5);
      }

      .timer-readout {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 19px;
        font-weight: 800;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: var(--text-primary);
        white-space: nowrap;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .timer-readout.warning {
        color: var(--amber-glow);
      }

      .timer-readout.critical {
        color: var(--crimson-glow);
        text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.7);
      }

      .timer-bar-track {
        width: 100%;
        height: 6px;
        background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22);
        border-radius: 4px;
        overflow: hidden;
        margin-top: 4px;
        position: relative;
      }

      .timer-bar-fill {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background: var(--primary-glow);
        transform-origin: left center;
        transform: scaleX(1);
        transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
      }

      .order-directive {
        margin-top: 3px;
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        color: #cbd5e1;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 6px;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      /* Top Right Cluster */
      .hud-right {
        grid-area: right;
        display: flex;
        align-items: stretch;
        gap: 6px;
        pointer-events: auto;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .icon-btn {
        width: 46px;
        min-height: 46px;
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: var(--panel-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
        color: var(--text-primary);
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        transition: transform 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
      }

      @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
        .icon-btn:hover,
        .icon-btn:focus-visible {
          border-color: var(--primary-glow);
          color: var(--primary-glow);
          transform: translateY(-1px);
          outline: none;
        }
      }

      .icon-btn:active {
        border-color: var(--primary-glow);
        color: var(--primary-glow);
        transform: scale(0.96);
      }

      /* Fever Banner Indicator */
      #fever-hud-banner {
        align-self: center;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
        padding: 4px 10px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: rgba(24, 10, 34, 0.94);
        border: 1px solid var(--secondary-glow);
        color: #f5d0fe;
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(232, 121, 249, 0.45);
        display: none;
      }

      #fever-hud-banner.active {
        display: block;
      }

      /* Critical Singularity Alarm Banner */
      #singularity-warning-banner {
        align-self: center;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
        padding: 4px 10px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: rgba(35, 10, 18, 0.96);
        border: 1px solid var(--crimson-glow);
        color: #fecdd3;
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.65);
        display: none;
        animation: pulseWarning 0.85s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
      }

      #singularity-warning-banner.active {
        display: block;
      }

      @keyframes pulseWarning {
        0% {
          box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35);
          border-color: #fb7185;
        }
        100% {
          box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.95);
          border-color: #f43f5e;
          transform: scale(1.01);
        }
      }

      /* Emergency Screen Vignette Border in Stage 4 */
      body[data-critical='true']::after {
        content: '';
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 8;
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 85px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.55);
        border: 2px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.6);
        animation: pulseEmergencyBorder 1.2s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
      }

      @keyframes pulseEmergencyBorder {
        0% {
          box-shadow: inset 0 0 55px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.35);
          border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4);
        }
        100% {
          box-shadow: inset 0 0 110px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.75);
          border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.9);
        }
      }

      .hud-sub-status {
        width: 100%;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        margin-top: 5px;
        font-size: 9.5px;
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .hud-sub-status-tag {
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--primary-glow);
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        text-align: left;
      }

      /* Modal Overlay Screens */
      .screen-overlay {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 20;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 20px;
        background: rgba(7, 8, 13, 0.78);
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        visibility: hidden;
        transition: opacity 0.18s ease;
      }

      .screen-overlay.visible {
        opacity: 1;
        pointer-events: auto;
        visibility: visible;
      }

      .modal-card {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 620px;
        background: rgba(11, 13, 22, 0.96);
        border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        padding: 30px 30px 26px;
        box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), 0 0 40px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.12), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        text-align: center;
        max-height: 90vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }

      .emblem-wrap {
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .eyebrow-tag {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--primary-glow);
        background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.1);
        border: 1px solid rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.28);
        padding: 4px 12px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
      }

      .game-title {
        font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 38px);
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        line-height: 1.08;
        color: var(--text-primary);
        text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.35);
        text-wrap: balance;
      }

      .game-subtitle {
        margin-top: 8px;
        font-size: 14px;
        line-height: 1.5;
        color: #cbd5e1;
        max-width: 48ch;
      }

      .shards-pill {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 5px 12px;
        border-radius: 9999px;
        background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.12);
        border: 1px solid rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.35);
        color: var(--primary-glow);
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin: 12px 0 6px;
      }

      .rules-grid {
        width: 100%;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 10px 14px;
        margin: 18px 0;
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: rgba(15, 20, 34, 0.9);
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16);
        text-align: left;
      }

      .rule-item {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 2px;
      }

      .rule-stage {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--primary-glow);
      }

      .rule-desc {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: #e2e8f0;
        font-weight: 500;
      }

      .records-strip {
        width: 100%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
        font-size: 13px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
      }

      .records-strip strong {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        color: var(--text-primary);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }

      .primary-cta-btn {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 15px 20px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        border: 1px solid #67e8f9;
        background: var(--accent-btn);
        color: #ffffff;
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        font-size: clamp(14px, 3.6vw, 17px);
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        cursor: pointer;
        box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
        transition: transform 0.14s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }

      @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
        .primary-cta-btn:hover,
        .primary-cta-btn:focus-visible {
          background: var(--accent-btn-hover);
          transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01);
          box-shadow: 0 0 36px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
          outline: none;
        }
      }

      .primary-cta-btn:active {
        background: var(--accent-btn-hover);
        transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99);
      }

      @keyframes pulseCta {
        0%, 100% {
          transform: scale(1);
          box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.45);
        }
        50% {
          transform: scale(1.02);
          box-shadow: 0 0 42px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.82);
        }
      }

      .pulsing-cta {
        animation: pulseCta 1.6s infinite ease-in-out;
      }

      .secondary-btn-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 12px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 12px;
      }

      .secondary-btn {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 12px 18px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28);
        color: var(--text-primary);
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: border-color 0.14s ease, background-color 0.14s ease;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .secondary-btn:hover,
      .secondary-btn:focus-visible {
        border-color: var(--primary-glow);
        background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 1);
        outline: none;
      }

      .control-hint-footer {
        margin-top: 16px;
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      }

      /* Game Over Stats Grid */
      .stats-grid-3 {
        width: 100%;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
        margin: 20px 0 16px;
      }

      .stat-tile {
        background: rgba(15, 21, 36, 0.92);
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
        border-radius: 10px;
        padding: 14px 10px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
      }

      .stat-tile-value {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 26px;
        font-weight: 800;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: var(--text-primary);
      }

      .stat-tile-sub {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--primary-glow);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }

      .near-miss-banner {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 11px 16px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.1);
        border: 1px solid rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.35);
        color: #a5f3fc;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
      }

      .near-miss-banner.new-best {
        background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.14);
        border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45);
        color: #6ee7b7;
      }

    <script>


      (function () {
        'use strict';

        const IS_HEADLESS = Boolean(
          navigator.webdriver || /HeadlessChrome/i.test(navigator.userAgent)
        );

        // LocalStorage Keys
        const STORAGE_HIGH_SCORE = 'qcc_high_score_v1';
        const STORAGE_BEST_WAVE = 'qcc_best_wave_v1';
        const STORAGE_SHARDS = 'qcc_quantum_shards_v1';
        const STORAGE_THEME = 'qcc_selected_theme_v1';
        const STORAGE_BEST_SURVIVAL = 'qcc_best_survival_v1';

        function loadHighScore() {
          try {
            return parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_HIGH_SCORE) || '0', 10) || 0;
          } catch (_) {
            return 0;
          }
        }

        function loadBestWave() {
          try {
            return parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_BEST_WAVE) || '1', 10) || 1;
          } catch (_) {
            return 1;
          }
        }

        function loadBestSurvival() {
          try {
            return parseFloat(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_BEST_SURVIVAL) || '0') || 0;
          } catch (_) {
            return 0;
          }
        }

        function saveBestSurvival(duration) {
          try {
            const prev = loadBestSurvival();
            if (duration > prev) {
              localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_BEST_SURVIVAL, String(duration));
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }

        function loadTotalShards() {
          try {
            return parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SHARDS) || '0', 10) || 0;
          } catch (_) {
            return 0;
          }
        }

        function saveTotalShards(shards) {
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SHARDS, String(shards));
          } catch (_) {}
        }

        function loadSelectedTheme() {
          try {
            return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_THEME) || 'cyan';
          } catch (_) {
            return 'cyan';
          }
        }

        function saveSelectedTheme(themeId) {
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_THEME, themeId);
          } catch (_) {}
        }

        function saveRecords(score, wave) {
          try {
            const prevScore = loadHighScore();
            const prevWave = loadBestWave();
            if (score > prevScore) {
              localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_HIGH_SCORE, String(score));
            }
            if (wave > prevWave) {
              localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_BEST_WAVE, String(wave));
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }

        // ============================================================================
        // PROCEDURAL WEB AUDIO SYNTHESIZER
        // ============================================================================
        class SoundSynth {
          constructor() {
            this.ctx = null;
            this.muted = false;
            this.droneOsc = null;
            this.droneGain = null;
            this.droneLfo = null;
            // Pentatonic ascending frequencies: C4 -> D4 -> E4 -> G4 -> A4 -> C5 -> D5 -> E5 -> G5 -> A5
            this.pentatonic = [
              261.63, 293.66, 329.63, 392.0, 440.0,
              523.25, 587.33, 659.25, 783.99, 880.0
            ];
          }

          ensureContext() {
            if (this.muted) return null;
            if (!this.ctx) {
              const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
              if (AudioCtx) {
                try {
                  this.ctx = new AudioCtx();
                } catch (_) {
                  return null;
                }
              }
            }
            if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
              this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
            }
            return this.ctx;
          }

          playPop(pitchIndex, isFever, themeId) {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const themeMultiplier = themeId === 'amber' ? 0.94 : themeId === 'emerald' ? 1.08 : 1.0;
            const freq = this.pentatonic[pitchIndex % this.pentatonic.length] * (isFever ? 1.25 : 1.0) * themeMultiplier;

            // Primary chime oscillator (clean sine/triangle, no harsh sawtooth buzz)
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = themeId === 'emerald' ? 'sine' : 'triangle';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.03, now + 0.14);

            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.24, now + 0.012);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0008, now + 0.28);

            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + 0.29);

            // Harmonic overtone
            const subOsc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const subGain = ctx.createGain();
            subOsc.type = 'sine';
            subOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq * 2, now);
            subGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
            subGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.12, now + 0.01);
            subGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0008, now + 0.19);

            subOsc.connect(subGain);
            subGain.connect(ctx.destination);
            subOsc.start(now);
            subOsc.stop(now + 0.2);
          }

          playWaveClear(flawless) {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const notes = flawless
              ? [261.63, 329.63, 392.0, 523.25, 659.25]
              : [261.63, 329.63, 392.0, 523.25];

            notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
              const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
              const gain = ctx.createGain();
              osc.type = 'triangle';
              const start = now + idx * 0.055;
              osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, start);
              osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.015, start + 0.35);

              gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, start);
              gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16, start + 0.02);
              gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0008, start + 0.42);

              osc.connect(gain);
              gain.connect(ctx.destination);
              osc.start(start);
              osc.stop(start + 0.44);
            });
          }

          playFeverTrigger() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'triangle';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(261.63, now);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(783.99, now + 0.24);

            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16, now + 0.025);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.28);

            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + 0.29);
          }

          playEmpBlast() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;

            const bass = ctx.createOscillator();
            const bassGain = ctx.createGain();
            bass.type = 'sine';
            bass.frequency.setValueAtTime(140, now);
            bass.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(32, now + 0.48);

            bassGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.32, now);
            bassGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.5);

            bass.connect(bassGain);
            bassGain.connect(ctx.destination);
            bass.start(now);
            bass.stop(now + 0.52);

            const sweep = ctx.createOscillator();
            const sweepGain = ctx.createGain();
            sweep.type = 'triangle';
            sweep.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now);
            sweep.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, now + 0.18);
            sweep.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(220, now + 0.42);

            sweepGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
            sweepGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16, now + 0.025);
            sweepGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.44);

            sweep.connect(sweepGain);
            sweepGain.connect(ctx.destination);
            sweep.start(now);
            sweep.stop(now + 0.46);
          }

          playPerkSelect() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            [392.0, 523.25, 659.25, 783.99].forEach((freq, idx) => {
              const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
              const gain = ctx.createGain();
              osc.type = 'triangle';
              const t = now + idx * 0.045;
              osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
              gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, t);
              gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.25);
              osc.connect(gain);
              gain.connect(ctx.destination);
              osc.start(t);
              osc.stop(t + 0.26);
            });
          }

          playMistakeGlitch() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;

            // Soft low-pitched damped tap instead of harsh sawtooth buzz
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, now);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(95, now + 0.14);

            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16, now + 0.01);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.15);

            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + 0.16);

          const parts = unsigned.split('/');
          if (parts.length !== 2 || !parts[0] || !parts[1]) return null;
          return {

            numerator: parts[0],
            denominator: parts[1],
          };

        function hasValueCollision(usedValues, candidate) {
          let collision = false;

        function pickUniqueFromList(list, getValue, usedValues) {
          const start = Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length);
          for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            const item = list[(start + i) % list.length];
            if (!hasValueCollision(usedValues, getValue(item))) {
              return item;

          }

        function generateWaveItem(wave, index, usedValues, _runDuration = 0) {
          const waveType = getWaveType(wave);

          for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 250; attempt++) {
            if (waveType === 'SINGLE_DIGIT') {
              // Waves 1-3: Clean positive single-digit numbers (1 to 9)
              const candidates = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9];
              const picked = pickUniqueFromList(candidates, (n) => n, usedValues);
              if (picked !== null) {
                return { value: picked, label: String(picked) };
              }
            } else if (waveType === 'DOUBLE_DIGIT') {
              // Waves 4-6: Mix of single and double digits (e.g., 6, 23, 58, 89)
              const wantSingle = index === 0 || (index > 2 && Math.random() < 0.3);
              const val = wantSingle
                ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 9) + 1
                : Math.floor(Math.random() * 90) + 10;
              if (!hasValueCollision(usedValues, val)) {
                return { value: val, label: String(val) };
              }
            } else if (waveType === 'TRIPLE_DIGIT') {
              // Waves 7-9: Incorporate three-digit integers alongside double-digit integers
              const wantTriple = index <= 1 || (index > 2 && Math.random() < 0.65);
              const val = wantTriple
                ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 900) + 100
                : Math.floor(Math.random() * 90) + 10;
              if (!hasValueCollision(usedValues, val)) {
                return { value: val, label: String(val) };
              }
            } else if (waveType === 'POS_NEG_INT') {
              // Waves 10-12: Introduce negative integers alongside positive numbers (e.g., -45, -12, 0, 18, 150)
              const wantNeg = index <= 1 || (index >= 4 && Math.random() < 0.5);
              const val = wantNeg
                ? -(Math.floor(Math.random() * 95) + 1)
                : Math.floor(Math.random() * 180);
              if (!hasValueCollision(usedValues, val)) {
                return { value: val, label: String(val) };
              }
            } else if (waveType === 'DECIMALS_INT') {
              // Waves 13-15: Incorporate simple decimals alongside integers (e.g., -6, 0.25, 0.75, 2, 4.5)
              const wantDecimal = index <= 1 || (index >= 4 && Math.random() < 0.5);
              if (wantDecimal) {
                const d = pickUniqueFromList(DECIMALS_POOL, (n) => n, usedValues);
                if (d !== null) {
                  return { value: d, label: String(d) };
                }
              } else {
                const isNeg = index === 2 || (index > 3 && Math.random() < 0.45);
                const val = isNeg
                  ? -(Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 1)
                  : Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
                if (!hasValueCollision(usedValues, val)) {
                  return { value: val, label: String(val) };
                }
              }
            } else if (waveType === 'FRACTIONS_SAME_NUMERATOR') {
              // Same Numerator, Different Denominators (e.g. Wave 14 -> 1, Wave 15 -> 2)
              const fixedNumerator = Math.max(1, ((wave - 14 + 100) % 3) + 1);
              const denominators = [
                fixedNumerator + 1,
                fixedNumerator + 2,
                fixedNumerator + 3,
                fixedNumerator + 4,
                fixedNumerator + 5,
                fixedNumerator + 6,
                fixedNumerator + 7,
                fixedNumerator + 8,
                fixedNumerator + 9,
              ];
              const den = pickUniqueFromList(
                denominators,
                (d) => fixedNumerator / d,
                usedValues
              );
              if (den !== null) {
                const val = fixedNumerator / den;
                return {
                  value: val,
                  label: fixedNumerator + '/' + den,
                  fractionGauge: val,
                };
              }
            } else if (waveType === 'FRACTIONS_SAME_DENOMINATOR') {
              // Same Denominator, Different Numerators (e.g. Wave 16 -> 10, Wave 17 -> 11)
              const fixedDenominator = Math.max(2, 10 + ((wave - 16 + 100) % 3));
              const numerators = [];
              for (let n = 1; n < fixedDenominator; n++) {
                numerators.push(n);
              }
              const num = pickUniqueFromList(
                numerators,
                (n) => n / fixedDenominator,
                usedValues
              );
              if (num !== null) {
                const val = num / fixedDenominator;
                return {
                  value: val,
                  label: num + '/' + fixedDenominator,
                  fractionGauge: val,
                };
              }
            } else if (waveType === 'PURE_FRACTIONS') {
              // Waves 22-24: Mixed Numerators & Denominators with radial pie-slice indicator
              const f = pickUniqueFromList(FRACTIONS_POOL, (item) => item.value, usedValues);
              if (f !== null) {
                return { value: f.value, label: f.label, fractionGauge: f.fill };
              }
            } else if (waveType === 'TRI_SYSTEM_POS') {
              // Waves 25-27: Fractions + Decimals + Integers without negative values
              const category = index < 3 ? index : Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
              if (category === 0) {

                if (f !== null) {

              } else if (category === 1) {
                const d = pickUniqueFromList(DECIMALS_POOL, (n) => n, usedValues);
                if (d !== null) {
                  return { value: d, label: String(d) };
                }
              } else {
                const val = Math.floor(Math.random() * 18) + 1;
                if (!hasValueCollision(usedValues, val)) {

                }

            } else {
              // Waves 28+: The Ultimate Singularity - All Systems + Negatives
              const bucket = index < 6 ? index : Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);
              if (bucket === 0) {
                const nf = pickUniqueFromList(NEGATIVE_FRACTIONS_POOL, (item) => item.value, usedValues);
                if (nf !== null) {
                  return { value: nf.value, label: nf.label, fractionGauge: nf.fill };

              } else if (bucket === 1) {
                const nd = pickUniqueFromList(NEGATIVE_DECIMALS_POOL, (n) => n, usedValues);
                if (nd !== null) {
                  return { value: nd, label: String(nd) };

              } else if (bucket === 2) {
                const nInt = -(Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1);
                if (!hasValueCollision(usedValues, nInt)) {
                  return { value: nInt, label: String(nInt) };

              } else if (bucket === 3) {

                if (pf !== null) {
                  return { value: pf.value, label: pf.label, fractionGauge: pf.fill };

              } else if (bucket === 4) {

                if (pd !== null) {

                }
              } else {

                if (!hasValueCollision(usedValues, pInt)) {
                  return { value: pInt, label: String(pInt) };

          // Wide screens use the middle half; smaller screens keep at least 640px of play space when available.
          const sideInset = Math.max(15, Math.min(viewportW * 0.25, (viewportW - 640) * 0.5));
          return {
            left: sideInset,
            right: Math.max(60, viewportW - sideInset),
            top: hudBottom,
            bottom: Math.max(hudBottom + 80, viewportH - 15),
          };
        }

        function computeCoreScaleFactor(vw, count) {
          const isNarrowMobile = vw < 450;
          const isMobile = vw < 640;
          if (isNarrowMobile) return count >= 7 ? 0.72 : 0.78;
          if (isMobile) return count >= 8 ? 0.76 : 0.84;
          return count >= 8 ? 0.88 : 1.0;
        }

        function clampCoreToSafeArena(c, bounds) {
          const minX = bounds.left + c.radius;
          const maxX = Math.max(minX, bounds.right - c.radius);
          const minY = bounds.top + c.radius;
          const maxY = Math.max(minY, viewportH - c.radius - 15);

          if (c.x < minX) {
            c.x = minX;
            c.vx = Math.abs(c.vx);
          } else if (c.x > maxX) {
            c.x = maxX;
            c.vx = -Math.abs(c.vx);
          }

          if (c.y < minY) {
            c.y = minY;
            c.vy = Math.abs(c.vy);
          } else if (c.y > maxY) {
            c.y = maxY;
            c.vy = -Math.abs(c.vy);
          }
        }

        const BASE_GAME_TIME = 60.0;

        const game = {
          state: 'title', // 'title' | 'playing' | 'perk' | 'paused' | 'gameover'
          wave: 1,
          score: 0,
          combo: 0,
          maxCombo: 0,
          timeLeft: BASE_GAME_TIME,
          feverTimeLeft: 0,
          waveMistakes: 0,
          totalMistakes: 0,
          poppedInWave: 0,
          shardsEarnedThisRun: 0,
          empAvailable: true,
          perks: {},
          offeredPerks: [],
          currentTheme: loadSelectedTheme(),
          totalShards: loadTotalShards(),
          cores: [],
          shakeTrauma: 0,
          glitchTimer: 0,
          hitstopTimer: 0,
          waveTransitionTimer: 0,
          radarPulseTimer: 0,
          hoveredCoreId: null,
          pointerX: viewportW * 0.5,
          pointerY: viewportH * 0.5,
          timeElapsed: 0,
          runDuration: 0,
          highScoreBeforeRun: loadHighScore(),
          bestWaveBeforeRun: loadBestWave(),
        };

        function resizeCanvas() {
          const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
          const prevW = viewportW;
          const prevH = viewportH;
          const prevBounds = getArenaBounds();

          const measuredW = rect && rect.width > 0 ? Math.round(rect.width) : window.innerWidth;
          const measuredH = rect && rect.height > 0 ? Math.round(rect.height) : window.innerHeight;
          viewportW = Math.max(1, measuredW || 360);
          viewportH = Math.max(1, measuredH || 640);

          const dpr = IS_HEADLESS ? 1 : Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
          canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(viewportW * dpr));
          canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(viewportH * dpr));
          ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / viewportW, 0, 0, canvas.height / viewportH, 0, 0);

          if (Array.isArray(game.cores) && game.cores.length > 0) {
            const bounds = getArenaBounds();
            const scaleFactor = computeCoreScaleFactor(viewportW, game.cores.length);
            const sizeChanged = Math.abs(viewportW - prevW) > 4 || Math.abs(viewportH - prevH) > 4;

            for (let i = 0; i < game.cores.length; i++) {
              const c = game.cores[i];
              const baseRadius = 46 + ((c.id - 1) % 2) * 6;
              c.radius = Math.round(baseRadius * scaleFactor);

              if (sizeChanged && prevW > 0 && prevH > 0) {
                const prevMinX = prevBounds.left + c.radius;
                const prevMaxX = Math.max(prevMinX + 1, prevBounds.right - c.radius);
                const prevMinY = prevBounds.top + c.radius;
                const prevMaxY = Math.max(prevMinY + 1, prevH - c.radius - 15);

                const normX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (c.x - prevMinX) / (prevMaxX - prevMinX)));
                const normY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (c.y - prevMinY) / (prevMaxY - prevMinY)));

                const newMinX = bounds.left + c.radius;
                const newMaxX = Math.max(newMinX, bounds.right - c.radius);
                const newMinY = bounds.top + c.radius;
                const newMaxY = Math.max(newMinY, viewportH - c.radius - 15);

                c.x = newMinX + normX * (newMaxX - newMinX);
                c.y = newMinY + normY * (newMaxY - newMinY);
              }
              if (!c.popped) clampCoreToSafeArena(c, bounds);
            }
          }
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
        window.addEventListener('orientationchange', () => setTimeout(resizeCanvas, 50));
        if (window.visualViewport) {
          window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
          window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll', resizeCanvas);
        }
        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
          const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => resizeCanvas());
          ro.observe(canvas);
        }
        resizeCanvas();

        function applyTheme(themeId) {
          game.currentTheme = themeId || 'cyan';
          document.body.classList.remove('theme-cyan', 'theme-amber', 'theme-emerald');
        }

        applyTheme(game.currentTheme);

        function spawnWave(waveNum) {
          if (window.ToenowAnimals) window.ToenowAnimals.setWave('number-pop', waveNum);
          game.wave = waveNum;
          game.waveMistakes = 0;
          game.poppedInWave = 0;
          game.radarPulseTimer = game.perks.quantum_radar ? 0.4 : 0;

          // Update HUD text/banners first so getHudBottom() measures exact active HUD height
          syncHud();
          resizeCanvas();

          const count = getCoreCountForWave(waveNum, game.runDuration);
          const usedValues = new Set();
          const rawItems = [];

          while (rawItems.length < count) {
            const item = generateWaveItem(waveNum, rawItems.length, usedValues, game.runDuration);
            usedValues.add(item.value);
            rawItems.push(item);
          }

          const sortedByValue = [...rawItems].sort((a, b) => a.value - b.value);
          const scaleFactor = computeCoreScaleFactor(viewportW, count);

          const bounds = getArenaBounds();

          const themeHues = game.currentTheme === 'amber'
            ? [38, 48, 22, 12, 54, 30, 42, 18, 5]
            : game.currentTheme === 'emerald'
            ? [155, 170, 140, 180, 130, 162, 148, 175, 120]
            : [188, 285, 325, 160, 210, 42, 265, 195, 345];

          const newCores = [];

          sortedByValue.forEach((item, rankIndex) => {
            const radius = Math.round((46 + (rankIndex % 2) * 6) * scaleFactor);

            const minX = bounds.left + radius;
            const maxX = Math.max(minX, bounds.right - radius);
            const minY = bounds.top + radius + 6;
            const maxY = Math.max(minY, viewportH - radius - 18);

            // Keep initial spawn centered within a comfortable visual field on wide desktop monitors
            const halfSpanX = Math.min((maxX - minX) * 0.5, 380);
            const centerX = (minX + maxX) * 0.5;
            const spawnMinX = Math.max(minX, centerX - halfSpanX);
            const spawnMaxX = Math.min(maxX, centerX + halfSpanX);

            const halfSpanY = Math.min((maxY - minY) * 0.5, 310);
            const centerY = (minY + maxY) * 0.5;
            const spawnMinY = Math.max(minY, centerY - halfSpanY);
            const spawnMaxY = Math.min(maxY, centerY + halfSpanY);

            let x = centerX;
            let y = centerY;
            for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 110; attempt++) {
              const cx = spawnMinX + Math.random() * Math.max(0, spawnMaxX - spawnMinX);
              const cy = spawnMinY + Math.random() * Math.max(0, spawnMaxY - spawnMinY);
              let overlaps = false;
              for (let k = 0; k < newCores.length; k++) {
                const other = newCores[k];
                const dx = cx - other.x;
                const dy = cy - other.y;
                const minDist = radius + other.radius + 18;
                if (dx * dx + dy * dy < minDist * minDist) {
                  overlaps = true;
                  break;
                }
              }
              if (!overlaps) {
                x = cx;
                y = cy;
                break;
              }
            }

            x = Math.min(maxX, Math.max(minX, x));
            y = Math.min(maxY, Math.max(minY, y));

            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            let speed = 46 + Math.min(waveNum * 3.8, 50);
            // Deep Late-Game Board Entropy: +35% core speed at 8+ minutes
            if (game.runDuration >= 480) {
              speed *= 1.35;
            }
            if (game.perks.stabilizer_field) {
              speed *= 0.7; // -30% speed
            }
            if (game.perks.fever_overflow) {
              speed *= 1.2; // +20% speed
            }

            newCores.push({
              id: rankIndex + 1,
              value: item.value,
              label: item.label,
              fractionGauge: item.fractionGauge,
              radius,
              x,
              y,
              vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
              vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
              popped: false,
              hue: themeHues[rankIndex % themeHues.length],
              sides: rankIndex % 2 === 0 ? 6 : 8,
              rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
              rotSpeed: (rankIndex % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.4),
              pulsePhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
              errorFlash: 0,
              freezeTimer: 0,
              spawnScale: 0.65,
            });
          });

          game.cores = newCores;
          syncHud();
        }

        function syncBodyAttributes() {
          document.body.dataset.state = game.state;
          document.body.dataset.wave = String(game.wave);
          document.body.dataset.score = String(game.score);
          document.body.dataset.combo = String(game.combo);
          document.body.dataset.fever = String(game.feverTimeLeft > 0);
          document.body.dataset.emp = String(game.empAvailable);
          document.body.dataset.duration = String(Math.floor(game.runDuration || 0));
          document.body.dataset.critical = String((game.runDuration || 0) >= 480 && game.state === 'playing');
        }

        function syncHud() {
          hudScore.textContent = game.score.toLocaleString();
          hudCombo.textContent = game.combo + 'x';

          const isHighCombo = game.combo >= 5;
          const effectiveCombo = Math.min(game.combo, 5);
          const comboMult = (1 + effectiveCombo * 0.15) * (isHighCombo ? 1.5 : 1);
          const multStr = comboMult.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'X';
          hudComboLabel.textContent = 'COMBO · ' + multStr;
          hudComboLabel.style.color = isHighCombo ? 'var(--secondary-glow)' : '';

          hudComboPips.forEach((pip, i) => {
            pip.classList.toggle('active', game.combo > i);

          const runDur = game.runDuration || 0;
          const stageInfo = getTimerStageInfo(runDur);
          hudStageLabel.textContent = stageInfo.name;

            ? 'var(--crimson-glow)'
            : stageInfo.stage === 3

            : 'var(--primary-glow)';
          hudCapLabel.textContent = 'CAP: ' + stageInfo.maxBank.toFixed(0) + 's';
          hudSurvivalTimer.textContent = 'RUN: ' + formatSurvivalTime(runDur);

          singularityWarningBanner.classList.toggle('active', stageInfo.isCritical && game.state === 'playing');

          hudWave.textContent = 'WAVE ' + game.wave;
          hudWaveTier.textContent = getWaveTierName(game.wave, runDur);
          hudCenterCluster.classList.toggle('breather-mode', isBreatherWave(game.wave));

          const clampedTime = Math.max(0, game.timeLeft);
          hudTimer.textContent = window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive('number-pop') ? '∞' : clampedTime.toFixed(1) + 's';
          hudTimer.classList.toggle('warning', clampedTime <= 20 && clampedTime > 10);
          hudTimer.classList.toggle('critical', clampedTime <= 10 || stageInfo.isCritical);

          const maxCap = stageInfo.maxBank;
          const fillRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, clampedTime / maxCap));
          hudTimerBar.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + fillRatio.toFixed(4) + ')';
          if (stageInfo.isCritical || clampedTime <= 10) {
            hudTimerBar.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--crimson-glow)';
          } else if (clampedTime <= 20) {
            hudTimerBar.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--amber-glow)';
          } else if (isHighCombo) {
            hudTimerBar.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--secondary-glow)';
          } else {
            hudTimerBar.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--primary-glow)';
          }

          const rem = game.cores.filter((c) => !c.popped).length;
          hudRemaining.textContent = rem + (rem === 1 ? ' BASKET LEFT' : ' BASKETS LEFT');

          syncBodyAttributes();
        }

        function setScreenState(nextState) {
          game.state = nextState;
          titleScreen.classList.toggle('visible', nextState === 'title');
          pauseScreen.classList.toggle('visible', nextState === 'paused');

        function startGame(startWave = 1, isPractice = false) {
          if (toenowSdk && !window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive('number-pop')) toenowSdk.startRun({ wave: startWave, isPractice });
          if (document.activeElement && typeof document.activeElement.blur === 'function') {

          game.bestWaveBeforeRun = loadBestWave();

          game.combo = 0;
          game.maxCombo = 0;

          game.runDuration = 0;
          game.feverTimeLeft = 0;
          game.waveMistakes = 0;
          game.totalMistakes = 0;
          game.poppedInWave = 0;
          game.shardsEarnedThisRun = 0;
          game.empAvailable = false;
          game.perks = {};
          game.shakeTrauma = 0;

        function reportScoreToHub(score, wave, runDuration, isPractice = false) {
          if (toenowSdk) {
            toenowSdk.reportGameOver({
              score: Math.round(Number(score) || 0),
              wave: Number(wave) || 1,
              duration: Math.round((Number(runDuration) || 0) * 1000),
              isPractice: Boolean(isPractice || game.isPractice)
            });

          }
          try {
            if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) {
              window.parent.postMessage(
                {
                  type: 'GAME_OVER',
                  gameId: 'number-pop',
                  category: 'math',
                  score: Math.round(Number(score) || 0),
                  wave: Number(wave) || 1,
                  runDuration: Number(runDuration) || 0,
                  duration: Math.round((Number(runDuration) || 0) * 1000),
                  isPractice: Boolean(isPractice || game.isPractice),
                },
                '*'
              );

          } catch (_) {}

        function triggerGameOver() {
          if (window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive('number-pop')) return;
          if (game.state === 'gameover') return;
          game.timeLeft = 0;
          sound.stopDrone();
          sound.playGameOver();

          const prevBest = game.highScoreBeforeRun;

          if (!game.isPractice) {

            saveBestSurvival(game.runDuration);

          game.totalShards += game.shardsEarnedThisRun;

          ToenowScreens.updateGameOver('number-pop', { score: game.score, bestScore: newBestScore, wave: game.wave, combo: game.maxCombo });
                    setScreenState('gameover');

          reportScoreToHub(game.score, game.wave, game.runDuration);

        function togglePause() {
