        // ============================================================================
        // CORE SELECTION & HIT HANDLING
        // ============================================================================
        function getLowestUnpoppedCore() {
          let lowest = null;
          for (let i = 0; i < game.cores.length; i++) {
            const c = game.cores[i];
            if (!c.popped) {
              if (!lowest || c.value < lowest.value) {
                lowest = c;
              }
            }
          }
          return lowest;
        }

        function handleCoreSelection(core) {
          if (!core || core.popped || game.state !== 'playing') return;
          if (window.ToenowTutorials?.isComplete('number-pop') && window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive('number-pop')) return;

          const lowestCore = getLowestUnpoppedCore();
          if (!lowestCore) return;

          if (Math.abs(core.value - lowestCore.value) < 1e-6) {
            if (window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive('number-pop')) {
              core.popped = true;
              game.poppedInWave++;
              sound.playPop(game.poppedInWave, false, 'cyan');
              spawnShatterBurst(core.x, core.y, core.hue, 20, false);
              if (!getLowestUnpoppedCore()) window.ToenowTutorials.complete('number-pop');
              syncHud();
              return;
            }
            // CORRECT ASCENDING CLICK (Musical chime + combo bonus, NO screen shake!)
            // Always allow popping the target lowest core immediately even if it had freezeTimer from an earlier misclick
            core.freezeTimer = 0;
            core.errorFlash = 0;
            core.popped = true;
            if (window.ToenowAnimals) window.ToenowAnimals.feedback('number-pop', true);
            harvestPickup = { x: core.x, y: core.y, until: performance.now() + 650 };
            game.combo += 1;
            game.shardsEarnedThisRun += 1;

            if (game.combo > game.maxCombo) {
              game.maxCombo = game.combo;
            }

            const isHighCombo = game.combo >= 5;
            if (isHighCombo) {
              game.feverTimeLeft = 5.0;
            }

            const effectiveCombo = Math.min(game.combo, 5);
            const highComboBonus = isHighCombo ? 1.5 : 1.0;
            const comboFactor = 1 + effectiveCombo * 0.15;

            let pointsAdded = Math.round((100 + game.wave * 25) * comboFactor * highComboBonus);
            game.score += pointsAdded;

            sound.playPop(game.poppedInWave, false, 'cyan');
            game.poppedInWave += 1;

            // Explicitly NO screen shake and NO hitstop on correct clicks
            game.shakeTrauma = 0;
            game.hitstopTimer = 0;

            spawnShatterBurst(core.x, core.y, core.hue, 20, false);

            const comboTag = game.combo > 1 ? 'COMBO ' + game.combo + 'x' : '';
            spawnFloatingText(
              core.x,
              core.y - 10,
              '+' + pointsAdded,
              comboTag,
              isHighCombo ? 'var(--secondary-glow)' : 'var(--primary-glow)'
            );

            // Check Wave Clear
            const remaining = game.cores.filter((c) => !c.popped).length;
            if (remaining === 0) {
              if (!game.isPractice && !window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive('number-pop')) toenowSdk?.reportProgress({ wave: game.wave + 1 });
              const flawless = game.waveMistakes === 0;
              sound.playWaveClear(flawless);
              if (flawless) {
                const maxBank = getMaxBankableTime(game.runDuration);
                const addedBonus = 2.5;
                if (game.timeLeft + addedBonus > maxBank) {
                  const surplus = (game.timeLeft + addedBonus) - maxBank;
                  game.timeLeft = maxBank;
                  const surplusPts = Math.round(surplus * 250);
                  game.score += surplusPts;
                  spawnFloatingText(
                    viewportW * 0.5,
                    viewportH * 0.42,
                    `+${surplusPts} FLAWLESS SURPLUS PTS!`,
                    `TIME AT MAX CAP ${maxBank}s`,
                    'var(--emerald-glow)'
                  );
                } else {
                  game.timeLeft += addedBonus;
                  spawnFloatingText(
                    viewportW * 0.5,
                    viewportH * 0.42,
                    '+2.5s FLAWLESS WAVE!',
                    'WAVE ' + game.wave + ' CLEARED',
                    'var(--emerald-glow)'
                  );
                }
              } else {
                spawnFloatingText(
                  viewportW * 0.5,
                  viewportH * 0.42,
                  'WAVE ' + game.wave + ' CLEARED',
                  '',
                  'var(--primary-glow)'
                );
              }

              game.waveTransitionTimer = 0.1;
            }

            syncHud();
          } else {
            // If core is currently frozen from a recent misclick, ignore extra mistake spam
            if (window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive('number-pop')) {
              core.errorFlash = 0.4;
              core.freezeTimer = 0.35;
              sound.playMistakeGlitch();
              return;
            }
            if (core.freezeTimer > 0) return;

            if (window.ToenowAnimals) window.ToenowAnimals.feedback('number-pop', false);
            // MISTAKE: Slight screen shake + mistake sound
            game.combo = 0;
            game.feverTimeLeft = 0;
            game.waveMistakes += 1;
            game.totalMistakes += 1;

            core.errorFlash = 0.4;
            core.freezeTimer = 0.35;

            game.glitchTimer = 0.22;
            game.shakeTrauma = 0.35;
            sound.playMistakeGlitch();

            spawnFloatingText(
              core.x,
              core.y - 12,
              'COMBO BROKEN!',
              'PICK THE LOWEST BASKET',
              'var(--crimson-glow)'
            );

            syncHud();
          }
        }

        function getPointerCanvasPos(clientX, clientY) {
          const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
          const scaleX = rect && rect.width > 0 ? viewportW / rect.width : 1;
          const scaleY = rect && rect.height > 0 ? viewportH / rect.height : 1;
          return {
            x: (clientX - (rect ? rect.left : 0)) * scaleX,
            y: (clientY - (rect ? rect.top : 0)) * scaleY,
          };
        }

        function findHitCoreAt(px, py) {
          const lowestCore = getLowestUnpoppedCore();
          let bestCore = null;
          let minDistSq = Infinity;
          let lowestCoreMatched = false;

          for (let i = 0; i < game.cores.length; i++) {
            const c = game.cores[i];
            if (c.popped) continue;

            // Check both current position and 45ms lag-compensated position for moving targets
            const dxNow = px - c.x;
            const dyNow = py - c.y;
            const dSqNow = dxNow * dxNow + dyNow * dyNow;

            const prevX = c.x - c.vx * 0.045;
            const prevY = c.y - c.vy * 0.045;
            const dxPrev = px - prevX;
            const dyPrev = py - prevY;
            const dSqPrev = dxPrev * dxPrev + dyPrev * dyPrev;

            const dSq = Math.min(dSqNow, dSqPrev);
            const hitR = c.radius + TOUCH_HITBOX_EXPANSION;

            if (dSq <= hitR * hitR) {
              if (lowestCore && c.id === lowestCore.id) {
                lowestCoreMatched = true;
              }
              if (dSq < minDistSq) {
                minDistSq = dSq;
                bestCore = c;
              }
            }
          }

          // If the tap landed within the target lowest core's hitbox and isn't deep inside another core's center, favor the target core
          if (
            lowestCoreMatched &&
            lowestCore &&
            bestCore &&
            bestCore.id !== lowestCore.id &&
            minDistSq > bestCore.radius * bestCore.radius * 0.45
          ) {
            return lowestCore;
          }

          return bestCore;
        }

        // Pointer Down (with exact CSS-to-canvas coordinate scaling + 20px touch hitbox expansion)
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
          if (game.state === 'playing' && game.waveTransitionTimer > 0) {
            // Complete transition immediately if player taps eagerly
            game.waveTransitionTimer = 0;
            spawnWave(game.wave + 1);
          }
          if (game.state !== 'playing') return;
          e.preventDefault();

          const pt = getPointerCanvasPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);
          game.pointerX = pt.x;
          game.pointerY = pt.y;

          const hitCore = findHitCoreAt(pt.x, pt.y);
          if (hitCore) {
            handleCoreSelection(hitCore);
          }
        });

        canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
          const pt = getPointerCanvasPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);
          game.pointerX = pt.x;
          game.pointerY = pt.y;

          const hoveredCore = findHitCoreAt(pt.x, pt.y);
          game.hoveredCoreId = hoveredCore ? hoveredCore.id : null;
          canvas.style.cursor = hoveredCore ? 'pointer' : 'crosshair';
        });

        // Keyboard Shortcuts
        window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.repeat) return;

          if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {
            if (game.state === 'title' || game.state === 'gameover') {
              e.preventDefault();
              startGame();
              return;
            } else if (game.state === 'paused' && e.code === 'Space') {
              e.preventDefault();
              togglePause();
              return;
            }
          }

          if (e.code === 'KeyP' || e.code === 'Escape') {
            if (game.state === 'playing' || game.state === 'paused') {
              e.preventDefault();
              togglePause();
              return;
            }
          }

          if (e.code === 'KeyR') {
            if (game.state === 'playing' || game.state === 'paused' || game.state === 'gameover') {
              e.preventDefault();
              startGame();
              return;
            }
          }

          if (e.code === 'KeyM') {
            e.preventDefault();
            toggleMute();
            return;
          }
        });

        // Zero-latency UI Button Handler helper (responds immediately on pointerdown + click fallback)
        function bindFastButton(id, handler) {
          const el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (!el) return;
          let lastTriggered = 0;
          const invoke = (e) => {
            const now = performance.now();
            if (now - lastTriggered < 250) return;
            lastTriggered = now;
            if (e.type === 'pointerdown') {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
            }
            if (typeof el.blur === 'function') el.blur();
            handler(e);
          };
          el.addEventListener('pointerdown', invoke);
          el.addEventListener('click', invoke);
        }

        function handleQuitOrRestartRun(nextAction) {
          if (!game.isPractice && game.score > 0) {
            saveRecords(game.score, game.wave);
            saveBestSurvival(game.runDuration);
            reportScoreToHub(game.score, game.wave, game.runDuration);
          }
          nextAction();
        }

        bindFastButton('btn-start', () => startGame());
        bindFastButton('btn-retry', () => startGame());
        bindFastButton('btn-resume', () => togglePause());
        bindFastButton('btn-pause-restart', () => handleQuitOrRestartRun(() => startGame()));
        bindFastButton('btn-pause-title', () => handleQuitOrRestartRun(() => setScreenState('title')));
        bindFastButton('btn-go-title', () => setScreenState('title'));
        bindFastButton('btn-pause', () => togglePause());
        bindFastButton('btn-restart-hud', () => handleQuitOrRestartRun(() => startGame()));

        // Also report score if browser tab / iframe unloads during an active run
        window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
          if (!game.isPractice && game.score > 0) {
            saveRecords(game.score, game.wave);
            saveBestSurvival(game.runDuration);
            reportScoreToHub(game.score, game.wave, game.runDuration);
          }
        });

        function toggleMute() {
          sound.muted = !sound.muted;
          document.getElementById('svg-unmuted').style.display = sound.muted ? 'none' : 'block';
          document.getElementById('svg-muted').style.display = sound.muted ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        bindFastButton('btn-mute', () => toggleMute());

        // ============================================================================
        // SIMULATION UPDATE & RENDER LOOP
        // ============================================================================
        function updatePhysicsAndParticles(dt, simDt) {
          // Ambient dust
          for (let i = 0; i < ambientDust.length; i++) {
            const d = ambientDust[i];
            d.x += d.vx * dt;
            d.y += d.vy * dt;
            if (d.y < -10) d.y = viewportH + 10;
            if (d.x < -10) d.x = viewportW + 10;
            if (d.x > viewportW + 10) d.x = -10;
          }

          // Pooled particles & shockwaves
          for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
            const p = particlePool[i];
            if (!p.active) continue;
            if (p.isShockwave) {
              p.radius += (p.maxRadius - p.radius) * dt * 8;
              p.alpha -= p.decay * dt;
              if (p.alpha <= 0 || p.radius >= p.maxRadius * 0.98) {
                p.active = false;
              }
            } else {
              p.x += p.vx * dt;
              p.y += p.vy * dt;
              p.vx *= 0.96;
              p.vy *= 0.96;
              p.alpha -= p.decay * dt;
              if (p.alpha <= 0) {
                p.active = false;
              }
            }
          }

          // Floating combat texts
          for (let i = 0; i < MAX_FLOATING_TEXTS; i++) {
            const ft = floatingTexts[i];
            if (!ft.active) continue;
            ft.y += ft.vy * dt;
            ft.scale = Math.max(1.0, ft.scale - dt * 1.2);
            ft.alpha -= dt * 1.15;
            if (ft.alpha <= 0) {
              ft.active = false;
            }
          }

          const bounds = getArenaBounds();
          const active = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < game.cores.length; i++) {
            const c = game.cores[i];
            if (!c.popped) active.push(c);
          }

          const isFever = game.feverTimeLeft > 0;

          // Update cores position, border bounce, and rotation
          for (let i = 0; i < active.length; i++) {
            const c = active[i];

            // If core is frozen from misclick, decrement freeze timer and apply subtle vibration
            if (c.freezeTimer > 0) {
              c.freezeTimer = Math.max(0, c.freezeTimer - dt);
              c.errorFlash = Math.max(0, c.errorFlash - dt);
              c.rotation += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
              clampCoreToSafeArena(c, bounds);
              continue; // Don't advance coordinates while frozen
            }

            c.x += c.vx * simDt;
            c.y += c.vy * simDt;
            c.rotation += c.rotSpeed * simDt;
            c.pulsePhase += dt * 3.8;
            if (c.spawnScale < 1) {
              c.spawnScale = Math.min(1, c.spawnScale + dt * 5.5);
            }
            if (c.errorFlash > 0) {
              c.errorFlash = Math.max(0, c.errorFlash - dt);
            }

            clampCoreToSafeArena(c, bounds);

            if (isFever && !IS_HEADLESS && Math.random() < 0.35) {
              spawnParticle(
                c.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * c.radius * 0.8,
                c.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * c.radius * 0.8,
                -c.vx * 0.25,
                -c.vy * 0.25,
                2.6,
                (game.timeElapsed * 260 + c.id * 50) % 360,
                2.4
              );
            }
          }

          // Soft-body mutual repulsion
          for (let i = 0; i < active.length; i++) {
            for (let j = i + 1; j < active.length; j++) {
              const a = active[i];
              const b = active[j];
              const dx = b.x - a.x;
              const dy = b.y - a.y;
              const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
              const minDist = a.radius + b.radius + 14;

              if (distSq < minDist * minDist && distSq > 0.0001) {
                const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
                const nx = dx / dist;
                const ny = dy / dist;
                const overlap = minDist - dist;

                const push = overlap * 0.5;
                a.x -= nx * push;
                a.y -= ny * push;
                b.x += nx * push;
                b.y += ny * push;

                const rvx = b.vx - a.vx;
                const rvy = b.vy - a.vy;
                const velAlongNormal = rvx * nx + rvy * ny;
                if (velAlongNormal < 0) {
                  const impulse = -velAlongNormal * 0.92;
                  a.vx -= impulse * nx;
                  a.vy -= impulse * ny;
                  b.vx += impulse * nx;
                  b.vy += impulse * ny;
                }
              }
            }
          }

          // Re-clamp strictly inside safe arena boundaries after mutual repulsion so no core ever enters HUD
          for (let i = 0; i < active.length; i++) {
            clampCoreToSafeArena(active[i], bounds);
          }
        }

        function drawPolygon(ctx, cx, cy, radius, sides, rotation) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
            const theta = rotation + (i * Math.PI * 2) / sides;
            const px = cx + Math.cos(theta) * radius;
            const py = cy + Math.sin(theta) * radius;
            if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
            else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
          }
          ctx.closePath();
        }

        function drawCoreValueLabel(ctx, c, drawX, drawY, r) {
          const parsedFraction = parseFractionLabel(c.label);
          if (parsedFraction) {
            // Render stacked fraction: Numerator on top, Horizontal Fraction Bar in middle, Denominator on bottom
            const maxDigits = Math.max(
              parsedFraction.numerator.length,
              parsedFraction.denominator.length
            );
            const isCompact = parsedFraction.isSignedNegative || maxDigits >= 2;
            const fontSize = Math.max(11, Math.round(r * (isCompact ? 0.34 : 0.38)));
            ctx.font = '800 ' + fontSize + "px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

            // Optical vertical adjustment for uppercase/numeric glyphs in Canvas textBaseline='middle'
            const opticalY = Math.round(fontSize * 0.06);
            const vOffset = Math.max(8, Math.round(r * 0.24));
            const barHalfW = Math.max(
              Math.round(r * 0.21),
              Math.round(maxDigits * fontSize * 0.34)
            );

            let fracX = drawX;
            if (parsedFraction.isSignedNegative) {
              const minusWidth = Math.round(fontSize * 0.5);
              const gap = Math.round(fontSize * 0.16);
              const shift = Math.round((minusWidth + gap) * 0.5);
              fracX = drawX + shift;
              const minusX = fracX - barHalfW - gap - Math.round(minusWidth * 0.5);
              ctx.lineWidth = 4;
              ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.92)';
              ctx.strokeText('-', minusX, drawY + opticalY);
              ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
              ctx.fillText('-', minusX, drawY + opticalY);
            }

            // 1. Numerator (Top)
            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.92)';
            ctx.strokeText(parsedFraction.numerator, fracX, drawY - vOffset + opticalY);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
            ctx.fillText(parsedFraction.numerator, fracX, drawY - vOffset + opticalY);

            // 2. Horizontal Fraction Bar (Middle "—")
            ctx.save();
            ctx.lineCap = 'round';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(fracX - barHalfW, drawY);
            ctx.lineTo(fracX + barHalfW, drawY);
            ctx.lineWidth = 4.6;
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.92)';
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(fracX - barHalfW, drawY);
            ctx.lineTo(fracX + barHalfW, drawY);
            ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#f8fafc';
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.restore();

            // 3. Denominator (Bottom)
            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.92)';
            ctx.strokeText(parsedFraction.denominator, fracX, drawY + vOffset + opticalY);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
            ctx.fillText(parsedFraction.denominator, fracX, drawY + vOffset + opticalY);
          } else {
            // Standard Integer or Decimal Label
            const labelLen = c.label.length;
            const fontSize = Math.max(
              15,
              Math.round(r * (labelLen >= 5 ? 0.44 : labelLen >= 4 ? 0.5 : 0.58))
            );
            const opticalY = Math.round(fontSize * 0.06);
            ctx.font = '800 ' + fontSize + "px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.92)';
            ctx.strokeText(c.label, drawX, drawY + opticalY);

            ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
            ctx.fillText(c.label, drawX, drawY + opticalY);
          }
        }

        let harvestPickup = null;
        function drawHarvestBasket(ctx, x, y, r, error, hovered) {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.strokeStyle = error ? '#bc4555' : '#82573b';
          ctx.lineWidth = hovered ? 4 : 2.5;
          // The basket stays inside the original circular hit area.
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - r * 0.06, r * 0.75, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x-r*.92,y-r*.4); ctx.lineTo(x+r*.92,y-r*.4);
          ctx.lineTo(x+r*.72,y+r*.76); ctx.lineTo(x-r*.72,y+r*.76); ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fillStyle = error ? '#eaa79b' : '#d8ad72'; ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(114,78,45,.3)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          for (let i=-2;i<=2;i++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x+i*r*.27,y-r*.35);ctx.lineTo(x+i*r*.22,y+r*.7);ctx.stroke(); }
          for (let i=0;i<3;i++) { ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-r*.78,y+i*r*.22);ctx.lineTo(x+r*.78,y+i*r*.22);ctx.stroke(); }
          // Carrot tops identify the harvest while leaving the mathematical label clear.
          for (const side of [-1,1]) {
            const tipX=x+side*r*.68;
            ctx.fillStyle='#d98a46';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(tipX-r*.1,y-r*.48);ctx.lineTo(tipX+r*.1,y-r*.48);ctx.lineTo(tipX,y-r*.18);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle='#608652';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(tipX,y-r*.48);ctx.lineTo(tipX-r*.12,y-r*.74);ctx.moveTo(tipX,y-r*.48);ctx.lineTo(tipX+r*.12,y-r*.74);ctx.stroke();
          }
          // An opaque label protects fractions, exponents and operations from the weave.
          ctx.fillStyle = '#26382e';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r*.69,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }

        function renderArena() {
          const cw = canvas.clientWidth;
          const ch = canvas.clientHeight;
          if (cw > 0 && ch > 0 && (Math.abs(cw - viewportW) > 1 || Math.abs(ch - viewportH) > 1)) {
            resizeCanvas();
          }

          ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / viewportW, 0, 0, canvas.height / viewportH, 0, 0);
          ctx.save();

          ctx.fillStyle = '#dce8cf';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewportW, viewportH);

          // Apply Subtle Screen Shake (Triggered ONLY on Mistake, never on correct click or combo)
          if (game.shakeTrauma > 0.001) {
            const shakeMag = game.shakeTrauma * game.shakeTrauma * 14;
            const ox = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * shakeMag;
            const oy = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * shakeMag;
            ctx.translate(ox, oy);
          }

          const isHighCombo = game.combo >= 5;

          // Soft garden paths and planted borders stay outside the number labels.
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(132,150,92,.18)'; ctx.lineWidth = 18;
          for (let y=90;y<viewportH;y+=110) { ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(viewportW,y);ctx.stroke(); }
          if (harvestPickup && performance.now() < harvestPickup.until && window.ToenowAnimals) {
            // Rabbit hops to the basket the player actually harvested.
            const hop = Math.sin((harvestPickup.until-performance.now())/650*Math.PI)*12;
            window.ToenowAnimals.drawAnimal(ctx,'rabbit',harvestPickup.x,harvestPickup.y-hop,56);
          }

          // Render Active Quantum Cores
          for (let i = 0; i < game.cores.length; i++) {
            const c = game.cores[i];
            if (c.popped) continue;

            const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(c.pulsePhase) * 0.035;
            const r = c.radius * pulse * c.spawnScale;
            const isHovered = game.hoveredCoreId === c.id;
            const coreHue = c.errorFlash > 0 ? 350 : c.hue;

            ctx.save();

            // Glitch vibration offset if frozen from mistake
            let drawX = c.x;
            let drawY = c.y;
            if (c.freezeTimer > 0) {
              drawX += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
              drawY += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
            }

            drawHarvestBasket(ctx, drawX, drawY, r, c.errorFlash > 0, isHovered);

            // Intuitive Fraction Rim Gauge (Visual Pie Arc along outer rim)
            if (c.fractionGauge !== undefined && c.fractionGauge > 0) {
              ctx.save();
              const gaugeRadius = r * 0.96;
              const startAngle = -Math.PI / 2;
              const endAngle = startAngle + Math.PI * 2 * c.fractionGauge;

              // Glowing pie wedge fill
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(drawX, drawY);
              ctx.arc(drawX, drawY, gaugeRadius, startAngle, endAngle);
              ctx.closePath();
              ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + coreHue + ', 95%, 65%, 0.16)';
              ctx.fill();

              // Glowing outer arc stroke
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(drawX, drawY, gaugeRadius, startAngle, endAngle);
              ctx.lineWidth = 3.2;
              ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + coreHue + ', 95%, 78%, 0.85)';
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.restore();
            }

            // Typographic Value Label (Vertical Stacked Fraction or Number)
            drawCoreValueLabel(ctx, c, drawX, drawY, r);

            ctx.restore();
          }

          // Render Pooled Particles & Shockwaves
          for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
            const p = particlePool[i];
            if (!p.active) continue;
            if (p.isShockwave) {
              ctx.save();
              ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + p.hue + ', 95%, 68%, ' + p.alpha.toFixed(2) + ')';
              ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.restore();
            } else {
              ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + p.hue + ', 95%, 68%, ' + p.alpha.toFixed(2) + ')';
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.fill();
            }
          }

          // Render Floating Text Popups
          for (let i = 0; i < MAX_FLOATING_TEXTS; i++) {
            const ft = floatingTexts[i];
            if (!ft.active) continue;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, ft.alpha);
            ctx.translate(ft.x, ft.y);
            ctx.scale(ft.scale, ft.scale);

            ctx.font = "800 20px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.92)';
            ctx.strokeText(ft.text, 0, 0);
            ctx.fillStyle = ft.color;
            ctx.fillText(ft.text, 0, 0);

            if (ft.subtext) {
              ctx.font = "700 12px 'Outfit', sans-serif";
              ctx.strokeText(ft.subtext, 0, 18);
              ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
              ctx.fillText(ft.subtext, 0, 18);
            }
            ctx.restore();
          }

          // Subtle High-Combo Calm Border Tint (No Shake)
          if (isHighCombo) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(232, 121, 249, 0.35)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.strokeRect(2, 2, viewportW - 4, viewportH - 4);
          }

          // Red Mistake Glitch Overlay
          if (game.glitchTimer > 0) {
            const gAlpha = Math.min(0.24, game.glitchTimer);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(244, 63, 94, ' + gAlpha.toFixed(3) + ')';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewportW, viewportH);
          }

          // Critical Overload Emergency Dark-Red Vignette Border (8+ Minutes)
          if (game.runDuration >= 480) {
            const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(game.timeElapsed * 7);
            const vGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
              viewportW * 0.5,
              viewportH * 0.5,
              Math.min(viewportW, viewportH) * 0.38,
              viewportW * 0.5,
              viewportH * 0.5,
              Math.max(viewportW, viewportH) * 0.72
            );
            vGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(159, 18, 57, 0)');
            vGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(225, 29, 72, ' + (0.22 + pulse * 0.18).toFixed(3) + ')');
            ctx.fillStyle = vGrad;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewportW, viewportH);

            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(244, 63, 94, ' + (0.5 + pulse * 0.45).toFixed(3) + ')';
            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            ctx.strokeRect(2, 2, viewportW - 4, viewportH - 4);
          }

          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Main Animation Loop
        let lastFrameTime = performance.now();
        let lastHeadlessRender = 0;

        function frameLoop(now) {
          requestAnimationFrame(frameLoop);

          if (IS_HEADLESS && now - lastHeadlessRender < 48) {
            return;
          }
          lastHeadlessRender = now;

          const rawDt = (now - lastFrameTime) / 1000;
          lastFrameTime = now;
          const dt = Math.min(Math.max(rawDt, 0.001), 0.05);
          game.timeElapsed += dt;

          if (game.shakeTrauma > 0) {
            game.shakeTrauma = Math.max(0, game.shakeTrauma - dt * 2.2);
          }
          if (game.glitchTimer > 0) {
            game.glitchTimer = Math.max(0, game.glitchTimer - dt);
          }
          if (game.radarPulseTimer > 0) {
            game.radarPulseTimer = Math.max(0, game.radarPulseTimer - dt);
          }

          let simDt = dt;
          if (game.hitstopTimer > 0) {
            game.hitstopTimer = Math.max(0, game.hitstopTimer - dt);
            simDt = 0;
          }

          if (game.state === 'playing') {
            if (game.waveTransitionTimer > 0) {
              game.waveTransitionTimer -= dt;
              if (game.waveTransitionTimer <= 0) {
                spawnWave(game.wave + 1);
              }
            } else if (!window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive('number-pop')) {
              game.runDuration += dt;
              const decayMultiplier = getTimerDecayMultiplier(game.runDuration);
              game.timeLeft = Math.max(0, game.timeLeft - dt * decayMultiplier);

              // Shrinking time bank ceiling check & overflow
              const maxBank = getMaxBankableTime(game.runDuration);
              if (game.timeLeft > maxBank) {
                const surplus = game.timeLeft - maxBank;
                game.timeLeft = maxBank;
                game.score += Math.round(surplus * 250);
              }

              if (game.feverTimeLeft > 0) {
                game.feverTimeLeft = Math.max(0, game.feverTimeLeft - dt);
              }
              sound.updateDrone(game.runDuration, game.runDuration >= 480);
              syncHud();

              if (game.timeLeft <= 0) {
                triggerGameOver();
              }
            }
            updatePhysicsAndParticles(dt, simDt);
          } else if (game.state === 'title' || game.state === 'perk') {
            updatePhysicsAndParticles(dt, dt * 0.55);
          }

          renderArena();
        }

        // Expose inspection & testing methods
        window.__QUANTUM_GAME__ = {
          getState: () => ({
            state: game.state,
            wave: game.wave,
            waveType: getWaveType(game.wave),
            score: game.score,
            combo: game.combo,
            maxCombo: game.maxCombo,
            timeLeft: game.timeLeft,
            runDuration: game.runDuration,
            decayMultiplier: getTimerDecayMultiplier(game.runDuration),
            maxBank: getMaxBankableTime(game.runDuration),
            shakeTrauma: game.shakeTrauma,
            hudBottom: getHudBottom(),
            arenaBounds: getArenaBounds(),
            touchHitboxExpansion: TOUCH_HITBOX_EXPANSION,
            cores: game.cores.map((c) => ({
              id: c.id,
              value: c.value,
              label: c.label,
              parsedFraction: parseFractionLabel(c.label),
              fractionGauge: c.fractionGauge,
              radius: c.radius,
              hitRadius: c.radius + TOUCH_HITBOX_EXPANSION,
              x: c.x,
              y: c.y,
              popped: c.popped,
              freezeTimer: c.freezeTimer,
            })),
          }),
          setRunDuration: (seconds) => {
            game.runDuration = seconds;
            syncHud();
          },
          getRunDuration: () => game.runDuration,
          popLowestCore: () => {
            const lowest = getLowestUnpoppedCore();
            if (lowest) handleCoreSelection(lowest);
            return lowest ? lowest.value : null;
          },
          clickHighestCoreForMistake: () => {
            const unpopped = game.cores
              .filter((c) => !c.popped)
              .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
            if (unpopped.length > 1) {
              handleCoreSelection(unpopped[0]);
              return unpopped[0].value;
            }
            return null;
          },
          setWave: (w) => {
            spawnWave(w);
          },
          forceGameOver: () => {
            triggerGameOver();
          },
        };
        window.__TEST_HOOKS__ = window.__QUANTUM_GAME__;

        window.ToenowTutorials?.register('number-pop', {
          start() {
            startGame(1, true);
            game.cores = game.cores.slice(0, 3);
            const bounds = getArenaBounds();
            game.cores.forEach((core, i) => {
              core.value = i + 1;
              core.label = String(i + 1);
              core.fractionGauge = null;
              core.radius = Math.min(42, (bounds.right - bounds.left) / 8);
              core.x = bounds.left + (bounds.right - bounds.left) * (i + 1) / 4;
              core.y = bounds.top + (viewportH - bounds.top) * 0.55;
              core.vx = core.vy = 0;
            });
            syncHud();
          },
          stop() {
            sound.stopDrone();
            game.isPractice = false;
            game.score = game.combo = game.maxCombo = game.shardsEarnedThisRun = 0;
            game.waveTransitionTimer = 0;
            game.cores = [];
            setScreenState('title');
          },
          getGuide() {
            const core = getLowestUnpoppedCore();
            if (!core) return { done: true };
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            const sx = rect.width / viewportW, sy = rect.height / viewportH;
            return { prompt: 'Tap the baskets from smallest to largest: 1, 2, 3.', rect: {
              x: rect.left + (core.x - core.radius) * sx, y: rect.top + (core.y - core.radius) * sy,
              width: core.radius * 2 * sx, height: core.radius * 2 * sy
            }};
          }
        });

        // Initial Boot
          ToenowScreens.updateTitle('number-pop', { bestScore: loadHighScore(), bestWave: loadBestWave() });

        spawnWave(1);

        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (typeof ToenowLevels !== 'undefined' && ToenowLevels.setupPracticeMode) {
          ToenowLevels.setupPracticeMode({
            container: '#title-screen .unified-title-card',
            onStartGame: (startWave, isPractice) => {
              startGame(startWave, isPractice);
            }
          });
        }

        if (params.get('autostart') === '1') {
          startGame();
        } else {
          setScreenState('title');
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(frameLoop);
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

    <script>


      (function () {
        'use strict';

        // --- Persistent High Score Storage ---
        const STORAGE_KEY_SCORE = 'quantum_shell_best_score_v5';
        const STORAGE_KEY_WAVE = 'quantum_shell_best_wave_v5';

        // Initialize Toenow Game SDK
        const toenowSdk = typeof ToenowGameSDK !== 'undefined'
          ? new ToenowGameSDK({ gameId: 'ball-track', category: 'spatial', gameTitle: 'Ball Track' })
          : null;

        let bestScore = 0;
        let bestWave = 1;
        try {
          bestScore = Math.max(0, parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_SCORE) || '0', 10) || 0);
          bestWave = Math.max(1, parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_WAVE) || '1', 10) || 1);
        } catch (_e) {
          bestScore = 0;
          bestWave = 1;
        }

        function saveRecords(score, wave) {
          if (state && state.isPractice) return;
          if (window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track')) return;
          if (score > bestScore) bestScore = score;
          if (wave > bestWave) bestWave = wave;
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_SCORE, String(bestScore));
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_WAVE, String(bestWave));
          } catch (_e) {
            // Ignore storage errors in restricted iframes
          }
        }

        // --- Native Web Audio API Synthesizer (100% Silent Overdrive, Discrete Event Chimes Only) ---
        class QuantumAudioEngine {
          constructor() {
            this.ctx = null;
            this.muted = false;
            this.masterGain = null;
          }

          ensureContext() {
            if (this.muted) return null;
            if (!this.ctx) {
              const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
              if (!AudioCtx) return null;
              this.ctx = new AudioCtx();
              this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
              this.masterGain.gain.value = 0.28;
              this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
            }
            if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
              this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
            }
            return this.ctx;
          }

          toggleMute() {
            this.muted = !this.muted;
            if (this.masterGain && this.ctx) {
              this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(this.muted ? 0 : 0.28, this.ctx.currentTime);
            }
            return this.muted;
          }

          playUiClick(freq = 540) {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.35, now + 0.055);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.16, now);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.06);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + 0.065);
          }

          playRevealHum(targetCount = 1) {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const baseFreqs = [330, 440, 554.37, 659.25, 880];
            for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(targetCount + 1, baseFreqs.length); i++) {
              const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
              const gain = ctx.createGain();
              osc.type = 'sine';
              osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(baseFreqs[i], now + i * 0.04);
              gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.04);
              gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.11, now + i * 0.04 + 0.06);
              gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.45);
              osc.connect(gain);
              gain.connect(this.masterGain);
              osc.start(now + i * 0.04);
              osc.stop(now + 0.48);
            }
          }

          playCoreLockLatch() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'triangle';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(360, now);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(140, now + 0.085);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.22, now);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.09);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + 0.095);
          }

          playReadyChime() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, now); // Steady C5 mid tone
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18, now + 0.025);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.34);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + 0.36);
          }

          playGoTone() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const notes = [659.25, 880, 1046.5]; // Ascending E5 -> A5 -> C6 launch chord
            notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
              const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
              const gain = ctx.createGain();
              osc.type = 'triangle';
              osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + idx * 0.025);
              osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.06, now + idx * 0.025 + 0.24);
              gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now + idx * 0.025);
              gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18, now + idx * 0.025 + 0.02);
              gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + idx * 0.025 + 0.26);
              osc.connect(gain);
              gain.connect(this.masterGain);
              osc.start(now + idx * 0.025);
              osc.stop(now + idx * 0.025 + 0.28);
            });
          }

          playSwapWhoosh(stepIdx = 0) {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            const startF = 180 + (stepIdx % 5) * 20;
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(startF, now);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(startF * 1.35, now + 0.06);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(startF * 0.85, now + 0.13);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.065, now + 0.03);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.14);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + 0.15);
          }

          playCorrectTap(comboIdx = 1) {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5];
            const base = notes[Math.min(notes.length - 1, comboIdx - 1)];

            [base, base * 1.25].forEach((freq, i) => {
              const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
              const gain = ctx.createGain();
              osc.type = 'triangle';
              osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + i * 0.035);
              osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.08, now + i * 0.035 + 0.18);
              gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, now + i * 0.035);
              gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.035 + 0.22);
              osc.connect(gain);
              gain.connect(this.masterGain);
              osc.start(now + i * 0.035);
              osc.stop(now + i * 0.035 + 0.23);
            });
          }

          playWaveClearChord() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const chord = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5];
            chord.forEach((freq, idx) => {
              const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
              const gain = ctx.createGain();
              osc.type = 'sine';
              const t0 = now + idx * 0.04;
              osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
              gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, t0);
              gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.14, t0 + 0.03);
              gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.42);
              osc.connect(gain);
              gain.connect(this.masterGain);
              osc.start(t0);
              osc.stop(t0 + 0.44);
            });
          }

          playPartialDecryptChime() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            const chord = [440, 554.37, 659.25];
            chord.forEach((freq, idx) => {
              const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
              const gain = ctx.createGain();
              osc.type = 'triangle';
              const t0 = now + idx * 0.055;
              osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
              gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.14, t0);
              gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.32);
              osc.connect(gain);
              gain.connect(this.masterGain);
              osc.start(t0);
              osc.stop(t0 + 0.34);
            });
          }

          playShieldCrackleAlarm() {
            const ctx = this.ensureContext();
            if (!ctx) return;
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            [210, 155].forEach((freq, idx) => {
              const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
              const gain = ctx.createGain();
              osc.type = 'sawtooth';
              const t0 = now + idx * 0.06;
              osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
              osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.72, t0 + 0.16);
              gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.16, t0);
              gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.18);
              osc.connect(gain);
              gain.connect(this.masterGain);
              osc.start(t0);
              osc.stop(t0 + 0.19);
            });
          }

            const ctx = this.ensureContext();

            const waveScore = Math.max(0, cappedTotal - currentTotalScore);
            return {
              waveScore,
              newTotalScore: cappedTotal,
              doubleSurgeTriggered,
            };
          }

          const waveScore = Math.round(baseWavePoints * odMult * surgeMult);
          return {
            waveScore,
            newTotalScore: currentTotalScore + waveScore,
            doubleSurgeTriggered,
          };
        }

        function calculateSpeedMultiplier(remainingMs, totalSelectMs, streak) {
          if (totalSelectMs <= 0) return 1;
          const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remainingMs / totalSelectMs));
          const speedBonus = ratio >= 0.65 ? 1.5 : ratio >= 0.35 ? 1.2 : 1.0;
          const streakBonus = Math.min(1.5, Math.floor(Math.max(0, streak) / 2) * 0.25);
          return Math.round((speedBonus + streakBonus) * 10) / 10;

        function generateSwapSchedule(config) {
          const steps = [];
          const curvePool = ['bezier_cw', 'bezier_ccw', 'bezier_wide_cw', 'bezier_wide_ccw'];
          let lastPairKey = '';

          for (let i = 0; i < config.swapCount; i++) {
            let a = 0;
            let b = 1;
            let isRadialHop = false;

            if (config.isDualRing && config.innerRingCount > 0 && config.outerRingCount > 0) {
              const doRadialHop = Math.random() < config.radialHopChance;
              if (doRadialHop) {
                isRadialHop = true;
                a = Math.floor(Math.random() * config.innerRingCount);
                b = config.innerRingCount + Math.floor(Math.random() * config.outerRingCount);
              } else {
                const useInner = Math.random() < 0.45;
                if (useInner) {
                  a = Math.floor(Math.random() * config.innerRingCount);
                  b = Math.floor(Math.random() * config.innerRingCount);
                  if (b === a) b = (a + 1) % config.innerRingCount;
                } else {
                  const offset = config.innerRingCount;
                  const localA = Math.floor(Math.random() * config.outerRingCount);
                  let localB = Math.floor(Math.random() * config.outerRingCount);
                  if (localB === localA) localB = (localA + 1) % config.outerRingCount;
                  a = offset + localA;
                  b = offset + localB;
                }
              }
            } else {
              a = Math.floor(Math.random() * config.shellCount);
              b = Math.floor(Math.random() * config.shellCount);
              if (b === a) b = (a + 1) % config.shellCount;
            }

            const minIdx = Math.min(a, b);
            const maxIdx = Math.max(a, b);
            const key = `${minIdx}-${maxIdx}`;

            if (key === lastPairKey && config.shellCount >= 3) {
              b = (b + 1) % config.shellCount;
              if (b === a) b = (a + 2) % config.shellCount;
              isRadialHop =
                config.isDualRing &&
                ((a < config.innerRingCount && b >= config.innerRingCount) ||
                  (b < config.innerRingCount && a >= config.innerRingCount));
            }
            lastPairKey = `${Math.min(a, b)}-${Math.max(a, b)}`;

            const curve = curvePool[Math.floor(Math.random() * curvePool.length)];
            const jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
            const durationMs = Math.max(500, Math.round(config.swapDurationMs + jitter));

            steps.push({
              pairA: a,
              pairB: b,
              durationMs,
              curve,
              isDecelerationStep: false,
              isRadialHop,
            });
          }

          let tailAccumMs = 0;
          for (let i = steps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            steps[i].isDecelerationStep = true;
            steps[i].durationMs = Math.round(steps[i].durationMs * 1.25);
            tailAccumMs += steps[i].durationMs;
            if (tailAccumMs >= 800) break;
          }

          return steps;
        }

        function buildHexPattern() {
          const pCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          const w = 52;

          pCanvas.width = w;

          const pCtx = pCanvas.getContext('2d');

          function drawHex(cx, cy, r) {
            pCtx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
              const angle = (Math.PI / 3) * i + Math.PI / 6;
              const x = cx + r * Math.cos(angle);
              const y = cy + r * Math.sin(angle);
              if (i === 0) pCtx.moveTo(x, y);
              else pCtx.lineTo(x, y);
            }
            pCtx.closePath();
            pCtx.stroke();
          }

          drawHex(w / 2, h / 4, 24);
          drawHex(0, (h * 3) / 4, 24);
          drawHex(w, (h * 3) / 4, 24);
          hexPatternCanvas = pCanvas;
        }

        function getCapsuleRadius() {

          const isDual = state.config ? state.config.isDualRing : false;

            if (count >= 8) {
              return Math.max(16, Math.min(25, stageSpan * (isMobile ? 0.046 : 0.039)));
            }
            return Math.max(18, Math.min(27, stageSpan * (isMobile ? 0.05 : 0.042)));
          }

          if (count >= 9) {
            return Math.max(15, Math.min(24, stageSpan * (isMobile ? 0.045 : 0.038)));
          }
          if (count >= 7) {
            return Math.max(18, Math.min(27, stageSpan * (isMobile ? 0.052 : 0.044)));
          }
          if (count >= 5) {
            return Math.max(20, Math.min(30, stageSpan * (isMobile ? 0.058 : 0.048)));
          }
          return Math.max(22, Math.min(33, stageSpan * (isMobile ? 0.064 : 0.052)));
