        /**
         * Computes playboard geometry:
         * - Coaxially centered orbit (`cx = viewportWidth * 0.5`) aligned with Top & Bottom HUD
         * - Bounded central arcade stage (`max-width: 580px`) so preview and published full-screen match
         * - Top-Right anchored "TARGET" vertical lineup coordinates (`queueX`, `queueTopY`)
         */
        function getPlayboardGeometry() {
          const isMobile = viewportWidth < 520;
          const hudEl = document.getElementById('hud-top');
          const measuredHudBottom =
            hudEl && state.mode !== 'title' ? hudEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom : 0;
          const hudTopClearance = Math.max(isMobile ? 148 : 118, measuredHudBottom + 10);
          const hudBottomClearance = isMobile ? 84 : 90;
          const availH = Math.max(200, viewportHeight - hudTopClearance - hudBottomClearance);

          const stageW = Math.min(viewportWidth * 0.94, 580);
          const stageRight = viewportWidth * 0.5 + stageW * 0.5;
          const panelW = isMobile ? 66 : 86;
          const queueColW = panelW + (isMobile ? 8 : 14);

          // Keep orbit horizontally centered with the Top HUD & Bottom Overdrive button
          const cx = viewportWidth * 0.5;
          const cy = hudTopClearance + availH * (isMobile ? 0.55 : 0.52);

          const R = getCapsuleRadius();
          // Ensure centered orbit never collides with the top-right TARGET queue inside the stage
          const halfStageClear = Math.max(115, stageW * 0.5 - panelW - (isMobile ? 6 : 14));
          const maxRadiusFromStage = halfStageClear - R * 0.85;
          const maxRadiusFromHeight = availH * 0.41;
          const outerRadius = Math.max(
            R * 2.25,
            Math.min(162, maxRadiusFromStage, maxRadiusFromHeight)
          );
          const innerRadius = Math.max(R * 1.6, outerRadius * 0.52);

          const queueX = stageRight - panelW * 0.5;
          // Anchor TARGET queue at the top-right of the bounded stage below the HUD
          const queueTopY = hudTopClearance + R + (isMobile ? 34 : 40);

          return {
            cx,
            cy,
            innerRadius,
            outerRadius,
            queueX,
            queueTopY,
            queueColW,
            panelW,
            hudTopClearance,
            isMobile,
          };
        }

        // Compute Top-Right Vertical Target Lineup Coordinates downwards
        function computeTargetLineupPositions(targetCount) {
          const { queueX, queueTopY, isMobile } = getPlayboardGeometry();
          const R = getCapsuleRadius();
          const count = Math.max(1, targetCount);
          const gap = Math.max(R * (isMobile ? 2.02 : 2.12), isMobile ? 36 : 44);
          const coords = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            coords.push({
              x: queueX,
              y: queueTopY + i * gap,
              index: i,
            });
          }
          return coords;
        }

        // Strict 1:1 Circular Orbit Slot Coordinates
        function computeLiveSlotCoordinates() {
          const { cx, cy, innerRadius, outerRadius } = getPlayboardGeometry();
          const cfg = state.config;
          const coords = [];

          if (cfg && cfg.isDualRing) {
            const innerCount = Math.max(1, cfg.innerRingCount);
            const outerCount = Math.max(1, cfg.outerRingCount);

            for (let i = 0; i < innerCount; i++) {
              const baseAngle = -Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI * 2) / innerCount;
              const angle = baseAngle + state.innerRingAngle;
              coords.push({
                x: cx + Math.cos(angle) * innerRadius,
                y: cy + Math.sin(angle) * innerRadius,
                ring: 'inner',
                ringIndex: i,
              });
            }

            for (let j = 0; j < outerCount; j++) {
              const baseAngle = -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI / outerCount + (j * Math.PI * 2) / outerCount;
              const angle = baseAngle + state.outerRingAngle;
              coords.push({
                x: cx + Math.cos(angle) * outerRadius,
                y: cy + Math.sin(angle) * outerRadius,
                ring: 'outer',
                ringIndex: j,
              });
            }

            return coords;
          }

          const count = state.shells.length || (cfg ? cfg.shellCount : 3);
          for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const baseAngle = -Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI * 2) / count;
            const angle = baseAngle + state.boardRotationAngle;
            coords.push({
              x: cx + Math.cos(angle) * outerRadius,
              y: cy + Math.sin(angle) * outerRadius,
              ring: 'single',
              ringIndex: i,
            });
          }
          return coords;
        }

        function recomputeShellSlotPositions() {
          if (!state.shells.length) return;
          const slots = computeLiveSlotCoordinates();
          const lineupCoords = computeTargetLineupPositions(state.config.targetCount);
          for (const shell of state.shells) {
            const slot = slots[shell.slotIndex] || slots[0];
            shell.baseX = slot.x;
            shell.baseY = slot.y;
            shell.ring = slot.ring;
            if (shell.hasCore && typeof shell.targetOrder === 'number' && lineupCoords[shell.targetOrder]) {
              shell.lineupX = lineupCoords[shell.targetOrder].x;
              shell.lineupY = lineupCoords[shell.targetOrder].y;
            }
            if (state.phase === 'lineup' || state.phase === 'wave_ready') {
              if (shell.hasCore) {
                shell.x = shell.lineupX;
                shell.y = shell.lineupY;
              } else {
                shell.x = slot.x;
                shell.y = slot.y;
              }
            } else if (state.phase !== 'shuffle' && state.phase !== 'insert') {
              shell.x = slot.x;
              shell.y = slot.y;
            }
          }
        }

        function createTitleShowcaseShells() {
          state.config = getWaveConfig(1, 0, 0);
          state.boardRotationAngle = 0;
          state.innerRingAngle = 0;
          state.outerRingAngle = 0;
          state.shells = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            state.shells.push({
              id: i,
              slotIndex: i,
              ring: 'single',
              hasCore: i === 0,
              targetOrder: i === 0 ? 0 : -1,
              picked: false,
              x: 0,
              y: 0,
              baseX: 0,
              baseY: 0,
              lineupX: 0,
              lineupY: 0,
              shieldOpen: i === 0 ? 1 : 0,
              scaleX: 1,
              scaleY: 1,
              flash: 0,
              revealedState: 'none',
              trail: [],
            });
          }
          const slots = computeLiveSlotCoordinates();
          for (let i = 0; i < state.shells.length; i++) {
            state.shells[i].x = slots[i].x;
            state.shells[i].y = slots[i].y;
            state.shells[i].baseX = slots[i].x;
            state.shells[i].baseY = slots[i].y;
          }
        }

        function setBodyState(mode, phase) {
          state.mode = mode;
          state.phase = phase;
          bodyEl.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
          bodyEl.setAttribute('data-phase', phase);

          screenTitleEl.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'title');
          screenPerkEl.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'perk');
          screenPauseEl.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'paused');
          screenGameoverEl.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'gameover');

          // Show wave/staging banner centered at (cx, cy) during wave_ready, ready_banner, or go_banner
          const showBanner =
            mode === 'playing' &&
            (phase === 'wave_ready' || phase === 'ready_banner' || phase === 'go_banner');
          if (showBanner) {
            const { cx, cy } = getPlayboardGeometry();
            waveBannerEl.style.left = `${cx}px`;
            waveBannerEl.style.top = `${cy}px`;
          }
          waveBannerEl.classList.toggle('visible', showBanner);
          waveBannerEl.classList.toggle('ready-mode', phase === 'ready_banner');
          waveBannerEl.classList.toggle('go-mode', phase === 'go_banner');
        }

        function syncRunTime() {
          hudTimerEl.textContent = window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track') ? '∞' : state.runTimeSec.toFixed(1) + 's';
        }

        function endTimedRun() {
          if (state.mode !== 'playing' || window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track')) return;
          state.runTimeSec = 0;
          syncRunTime();
          saveRecords(state.score, state.wave);
          state.frozenSnapshot = { score: Math.round(state.score), wave: state.wave, best: Math.round(bestScore), reason: 'TIME EXPIRED' };
          showGameOverModal();
        }

        function updateHudReadouts() {
          hudScoreEl.textContent = String(Math.round(state.score));
          hudMultEl.textContent = state.currentMult.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'x';
          hudOverdriveMultEl.textContent = state.overdriveMultiplier.toFixed(1) + 'x';
          hudBestEl.textContent = String(Math.round(bestScore));
          ToenowScreens.updateTitle('ball-track', { bestScore: bestScore, bestWave: bestWave });
          // Exact required indicator format: "WAVE [X] | TARGET: [Y]"
          hudWaveTargetEl.textContent = `WAVE ${state.wave} | TARGET: ${state.config.targetCount}`;
          syncRunTime();
        }

        // Overdrive State Setter (100% Silent — Zero Audio Oscillator)
        function setOverdriveState(active) {
          const canOverdrive = state.mode === 'playing' && state.phase === 'shuffle';
          const nextState = Boolean(active && canOverdrive);
          if (state.isOverdrive === nextState) return;
          state.isOverdrive = nextState;
          btnOverdrive.classList.toggle('active', nextState);
        }

        // Strict Timer Gate Helper: Timer stays 100% FROZEN until "GO!"
        function setFrozenTimerHud(phaseLabel, colorHex = '#22d3ee') {
          hudPhaseTextEl.textContent = phaseLabel;
          hudPhaseTextEl.style.color = colorHex;
          syncRunTime();
          hudGaugeFillEl.style.transform = 'scaleX(1)';
          hudGaugeFillEl.style.backgroundColor = colorHex;
        }

        // --- Initialize Wave with Top-Right "TARGET" Lineup & READY -> GO! Staging ---
        function initWave(waveNum, showWaveBanner = true) {
          state.wave = waveNum;
          if (window.ToenowAnimals) window.ToenowAnimals.setWave('ball-track', waveNum);
          state.config = getWaveConfig(
            waveNum,
            state.bonusTimeBufferMs,
            state.perkCalmDriftCount
          );
          state.bonusTimeBufferMs = 0;
          state.mistakesThisWave = 0;
          state.waveStartScore = state.score;
          state.waveAwardedSoFar = 0;

          state.isOverdrive = false;
          state.overdriveHeldDurationMs = 0;
          state.overdriveMultiplier = 1.0;
          state.boardRotationAngle = 0;
          state.innerRingAngle = 0;
          state.outerRingAngle = 0;
          btnOverdrive.classList.remove('active');
          overdriveMultReadoutEl.textContent = 'BET MULTIPLIER: 1.0x -> 3.5x';
          hudOverdriveMultEl.textContent = '1.0x';

          const indices = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < state.config.shellCount; i++) indices.push(i);
          for (let i = indices.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
            const tmp = indices[i];
            indices[i] = indices[j];
            indices[j] = tmp;
          }
          const targetSet = new Set(indices.slice(0, state.config.targetCount));

          state.shells = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < state.config.shellCount; i++) {
            state.shells.push({
              id: i,
              slotIndex: i,
              ring: 'single',
              hasCore: targetSet.has(i),
              targetOrder: -1,
              picked: false,
              x: 0,
              y: 0,
              baseX: 0,
              baseY: 0,
              lineupX: 0,
              lineupY: 0,
              shieldOpen: targetSet.has(i) ? 1 : 0,
              scaleX: 1,
              scaleY: 1,
              flash: 0,
              revealedState: 'none',
              trail: [],
            });
          }

          // Assign vertical lineup order (0..targetCount-1) for target capsules in the top-right "TARGET" queue
          const slots = computeLiveSlotCoordinates();
          const targetShells = state.shells.filter((s) => s.hasCore);
          targetShells.sort((a, b) => slots[a.slotIndex].y - slots[b.slotIndex].y);
          const lineupCoords = computeTargetLineupPositions(state.config.targetCount);

          targetShells.forEach((s, idx) => {
            s.targetOrder = idx;
            s.lineupX = lineupCoords[idx].x;
            s.lineupY = lineupCoords[idx].y;
          });

          for (let i = 0; i < state.shells.length; i++) {
            const s = state.shells[i];
            const slot = slots[s.slotIndex];
            s.baseX = slot.x;
            s.baseY = slot.y;
            s.ring = slot.ring;
            if (s.hasCore) {
              // Target capsules start in the top-right TARGET lineup
              s.x = s.lineupX;
              s.y = s.lineupY;
            } else {
              // Decoy capsules sit on the circular track as dimmed neutral hulls
              s.x = slot.x;
              s.y = slot.y;
            }
          }

          state.swapSchedule = generateSwapSchedule(state.config);
          state.currentSwapIndex = 0;
          state.swapElapsedMs = 0;
          state.activeSwap = null;
          state.lastTickSecond = -1;

          saveRecords(state.score, state.wave);
          updateHudReadouts();

          if (showWaveBanner) {
            waveBannerTitleEl.textContent = `WAVE ${state.wave}`;
            state.phaseElapsedMs = 0;
            // Wave 1 display duration increased by +1.5s (520ms + 1500ms = 2020ms)
            state.phaseDurationMs = state.wave === 1 ? 2020 : 1200;
            setBodyState('playing', 'wave_ready');
            setFrozenTimerHud(`WAVE ${state.wave}`, '#22d3ee');
          } else {
            enterLineupPhase();
          }
        }

        function enterLineupPhase() {
          state.phaseElapsedMs = 0;
          state.phaseDurationMs = state.config.lineupDurationMs;
          setBodyState('playing', 'lineup');
          setFrozenTimerHud(`TARGET LINEUP (${state.config.targetCount})`, '#22d3ee');
          audio.playRevealHum(state.config.targetCount);
        }

        function beginShuffleStep(stepIndex) {
          if (stepIndex >= state.swapSchedule.length) {
            setOverdriveState(false);
            state.activeSwap = null;
            state.phaseElapsedMs = 0;
            state.phaseDurationMs = state.config.selectDurationMs;
            setBodyState('playing', 'select');

            // Strict Selection State Reset: All capsules look 100% uniform and neutral until tapped
            const slots = computeLiveSlotCoordinates();
            for (const s of state.shells) {
              const slot = slots[s.slotIndex] || slots[0];
              s.baseX = slot.x;
              s.baseY = slot.y;
              s.x = slot.x;
              s.y = slot.y;
              s.shieldOpen = 0;
              s.scaleX = 1;
              s.scaleY = 1;
              s.flash = 0;
              s.revealedState = 'none';
              s.trail.length = 0;
            }

            hudPhaseTextEl.textContent = `TAP TARGETS (${state.config.targetCount})`;
            hudPhaseTextEl.style.color = '#22d3ee';
            hudGaugeFillEl.style.backgroundColor = '#22d3ee';
            hudGaugeFillEl.style.transform = 'scaleX(1)';
            return;
          }

          const step = state.swapSchedule[stepIndex];
          const shellA = state.shells.find((s) => s.slotIndex === step.pairA);
          const shellB = state.shells.find((s) => s.slotIndex === step.pairB);

          if (!shellA || !shellB) {
            state.currentSwapIndex += 1;
            beginShuffleStep(state.currentSwapIndex);
            return;
          }

          const fromSlotA = shellA.slotIndex;
          const fromSlotB = shellB.slotIndex;
          shellA.slotIndex = fromSlotB;
          shellB.slotIndex = fromSlotA;

          const liveSlots = computeLiveSlotCoordinates();
          shellA.baseX = liveSlots[shellA.slotIndex].x;
          shellA.baseY = liveSlots[shellA.slotIndex].y;
          shellA.ring = liveSlots[shellA.slotIndex].ring;
          shellB.baseX = liveSlots[shellB.slotIndex].x;
          shellB.baseY = liveSlots[shellB.slotIndex].y;
          shellB.ring = liveSlots[shellB.slotIndex].ring;

          state.activeSwap = {
            shellA,
            shellB,
            fromSlotA,
            toSlotA: shellA.slotIndex,
            fromSlotB,
            toSlotB: shellB.slotIndex,
            durationMs: step.durationMs,
            curve: step.curve,
            isDecelerationStep: step.isDecelerationStep,
            isRadialHop: step.isRadialHop,
          };

          state.swapElapsedMs = 0;
          audio.playSwapWhoosh(stepIndex);
        }

        function startNewGame(startWave = 1, isPractice = false) {
          if (!Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track')) && toenowSdk) toenowSdk.startRun({ wave: startWave, isPractice });
          audio.playUiClick(580);
          if (document.activeElement && typeof document.activeElement.blur === 'function') {
            document.activeElement.blur();
          }
          state.score = 0;
          state.streak = 0;
          state.currentMult = 1;
          state.runTimeSec = ToenowTime.START_SECONDS;
          state.isPractice = Boolean(isPractice);

          state.mistakesThisWave = 0;
          state.bonusTimeBufferMs = 0;
          state.perkDoubleSurge = false;
          state.perkCalmDriftCount = 0;
          state.overdriveMultiplier = 1.0;
          state.overdriveHeldDurationMs = 0;
          state.isOverdrive = false;
          state.trauma = 0;
          state.hitstopMs = 0;
          floatingPopups.length = 0;
          initWave(startWave, true);
        }

        // --- Milestone Perk Modal Trigger (Every 3 Waves: Wave 3, 6, 9, 12...) ---
        function checkMilestonePerkTrigger(clearedWave) {
          if (clearedWave > 0 && clearedWave % 3 === 0) {
            state.pendingNextWave = clearedWave + 1;
            perkSubtitleEl.textContent = `Wave ${clearedWave} cleared! Choose a perk for Wave ${state.pendingNextWave}.`;
            setBodyState('perk', 'idle');
            return true;
          }
          return false;
        }

        function applyPerkChoice(perkType) {
          audio.playUiClick(680);
          if (document.activeElement && typeof document.activeElement.blur === 'function') {
            document.activeElement.blur();
          }
          if (perkType === 'time') {
            state.runTimeSec = Math.min(60, state.runTimeSec + 10);
          } else if (perkType === 'surge') {
            state.perkDoubleSurge = true;
          } else if (perkType === 'calm') {
            state.perkCalmDriftCount += 1;
          }
          updateHudReadouts();
          initWave(state.pendingNextWave, true);
        }

        // --- Capsule Selection (Direct Click / Tap Only) ---
        function handleShellSelection(shell) {
          if (state.mode !== 'playing' || state.phase !== 'select') return;
          if (!shell || shell.picked || (Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track')) && Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isComplete?.('ball-track')))) return;
          if (Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track'))) {
            if (!shell.hasCore) { audio.playUiClick(320); return; }
            shell.picked = true; shell.revealedState = 'correct'; shell.shieldOpen = 1; shell.flash = 0.25;
            audio.playCorrectTap(1); updateHudReadouts();
            if (state.shells.every(s => !s.hasCore || s.picked)) window.ToenowTutorials.complete('ball-track');
            return;
          }

          const remainingMs = Math.max(0, state.phaseDurationMs - state.phaseElapsedMs);

          // 1. Wrong / Empty Shell Selected -> Open shutter to show empty dark interior (ZERO light / ZERO flash)
          if (!shell.hasCore) {
            shell.picked = true;
            shell.revealedState = 'wrong';
            if (window.ToenowAnimals) window.ToenowAnimals.feedback('ball-track', false);
            shell.shieldOpen = 1;
            shell.flash = 0;
            shell.scaleX = 0.94;
            shell.scaleY = 0.94;

            state.runTimeSec = ToenowTime.wrong(state.runTimeSec);
            state.mistakesThisWave += 1;
            state.streak = 0;
            state.currentMult = 1;
            state.hitstopMs = 45;
            state.trauma = Math.min(1, state.trauma + 0.35);

            audio.playShieldCrackleAlarm();
            syncRunTime();
            updateHudReadouts();

            spawnPopup(
              shell.x,
              shell.y - 44,
              'WRONG · -5s',
              state.runTimeSec.toFixed(1) + 's',
              '#f43f5e'
            );

            if (state.runTimeSec <= 0) { endTimedRun(); return; }

            hudPhaseTextEl.textContent = 'WRONG · -5s';
            hudPhaseTextEl.style.color = '#f43f5e';
            return;
          }

          // 2. Correct Target Capsule Selected! (Opens to reveal glowing cyan core)
          shell.picked = true;
          shell.revealedState = 'correct';
          if (window.ToenowAnimals) window.ToenowAnimals.feedback('ball-track', true);
          shell.shieldOpen = 1;
          shell.flash = 0.25;
          shell.scaleX = 1.14;
          shell.scaleY = 0.88;

          state.runTimeSec = ToenowTime.correct(state.runTimeSec);
          state.streak += 1;
          const mult = calculateSpeedMultiplier(
            remainingMs,
            state.phaseDurationMs,
            state.streak
          );
          state.currentMult = mult;

          // Compute total wave clear reward using the calibrated Wave 1-9 (<4,800 cap) / Wave 10+ formula
          const scoreCalc = calculateWaveClearScore({
            wave: state.wave,
            baseWavePoints: state.config.baseWavePoints,
            currentTotalScore: state.waveStartScore,
            overdriveMultiplier: state.overdriveMultiplier,
            hasDoubleSurge: state.perkDoubleSurge,
            mistakesThisWave: state.mistakesThisWave,
          });

          const totalTargets = Math.max(1, state.config.targetCount);
          const pickedTargetsNow = state.shells.filter((s) => s.hasCore && s.picked).length;
          const unpickedTargets = totalTargets - pickedTargetsNow;

          let pointsEarned = 0;
          if (unpickedTargets === 0) {
            pointsEarned = Math.max(0, scoreCalc.waveScore - state.waveAwardedSoFar);
            state.score = scoreCalc.newTotalScore;
          } else {
            const share = Math.floor(scoreCalc.waveScore / totalTargets);
            pointsEarned = share;
            state.waveAwardedSoFar += share;
            state.score = state.waveStartScore + state.waveAwardedSoFar;
          }

          saveRecords(state.score, state.wave);
          updateHudReadouts();

          state.hitstopMs = 45;
          state.trauma = Math.min(1, state.trauma + 0.22);
          triggerCoreCrackBurst(shell.x, shell.y, true);

          if (unpickedTargets === 0) {
            audio.playWaveClearChord();
          } else {
            audio.playCorrectTap(state.streak);
          }

          const subtextParts = [];
          if (state.overdriveMultiplier > 1.05) {
            subtextParts.push(`OVERDRIVE ${state.overdriveMultiplier.toFixed(1)}x`);
          }
          if (unpickedTargets === 0 && scoreCalc.doubleSurgeTriggered) {
            subtextParts.push('DOUBLE SURGE 2x');
          }
          if (subtextParts.length === 0) {
            subtextParts.push(unpickedTargets === 0 ? 'WAVE CLEAR' : 'TARGET LOCKED');
          }

          spawnPopup(
            shell.x,
            shell.y - 48,
            `+${pointsEarned}`,
            subtextParts.join(' · '),
            state.overdriveMultiplier > 1.05 ? '#ff7849' : '#22d3ee'
          );

          if (unpickedTargets === 0) {
            hudPhaseTextEl.textContent = 'WAVE CLEAR';
            hudPhaseTextEl.style.color = '#14b8a6';
            hudGaugeFillEl.style.backgroundColor = '#14b8a6';
            state.phaseElapsedMs = 0;
            state.phaseDurationMs = 760;
            setBodyState('playing', 'wave_clear');
          }
        }

        function showGameOverModal() {
          if (Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track'))) return;
          ToenowScreens.updateGameOver('ball-track', { score: state.frozenSnapshot.score, bestScore: state.frozenSnapshot.best, wave: state.frozenSnapshot.wave, combo: null, reason: 'TIME EXPIRED' });
                    setBodyState('gameover', 'idle');

          // Toenow Game SDK Unified Lifecycle & Hub Contract
          if (toenowSdk) {
            toenowSdk.reportGameOver({
              score: Math.round(state.frozenSnapshot.score || state.score || 0),
              wave: state.frozenSnapshot.wave || state.wave || 1,
              isPractice: Boolean(state.isPractice)
            });
          } else {
            try {
              if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) {
                window.parent.postMessage(
                  {
                    type: 'GAME_OVER',
                    gameId: 'ball-track',
                    category: 'spatial',
                    score: Math.round(state.frozenSnapshot.score || state.score || 0),
                    wave: state.frozenSnapshot.wave || state.wave || 1,
                    isPractice: Boolean(state.isPractice)
                  },
                  '*'
                );
              }
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }

        function togglePause() {
          audio.playUiClick(460);
          if (state.mode === 'playing') {
            pauseStatScoreEl.textContent = String(Math.round(state.score));
            pauseStatWaveEl.textContent = String(state.wave);
            pauseStatTimeEl.textContent = state.runTimeSec.toFixed(1) + 's';
            setOverdriveState(false);
            setBodyState('paused', state.phase);
          } else if (state.mode === 'paused') {
            if (document.activeElement && typeof document.activeElement.blur === 'function') {
              document.activeElement.blur();
            }
            setBodyState('playing', state.phase);
          }
        }

        function returnToTitle() {
          audio.playUiClick(420);
          if (document.activeElement && typeof document.activeElement.blur === 'function') {
            document.activeElement.blur();
          }
          setOverdriveState(false);
          createTitleShowcaseShells();
          updateHudReadouts();
          setBodyState('title', 'idle');
        }

        function screenToWorld(clientX, clientY) {
          const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
          return {
            x: clientX - rect.left,
            y: clientY - rect.top,
          };
        }

        function findShellAtPoint(wx, wy) {
          const R = getCapsuleRadius();
          const hitRadius = Math.max(32, R * 1.42);
          let closest = null;
          let bestDist = hitRadius;

          for (const s of state.shells) {
            const dx = wx - s.x;
            const dy = wy - s.y;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            if (dist <= bestDist) {
              bestDist = dist;
              closest = s;
            }
          }
          return closest;
        }

        canvas.addEventListener(
          'pointermove',
          (e) => {
            const pt = screenToWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            state.pointerX = pt.x;
            state.pointerY = pt.y;
          },
          { passive: true }
        );

        canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
          const pt = screenToWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
          state.pointerX = pt.x;
          state.pointerY = pt.y;
          if (state.mode === 'playing' && state.phase === 'select') {
            const picked = findShellAtPoint(pt.x, pt.y);
            if (picked) {
              handleShellSelection(picked);
            }
          }
        });

        // Player-Controlled Overdrive Hold Listeners (100% Silent Visual-Only Feedback)
        btnOverdrive.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setOverdriveState(true);
        });
        window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
          if (state.isOverdrive) setOverdriveState(false);
        });
        window.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
          if (state.isOverdrive) setOverdriveState(false);
        });

        // Keyboard Controls: Shift for Overdrive, P/Escape for Pause, M for Mute, R for Restart
        // (No Tab or keyboard capsule pre-selection)
        window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          const key = e.key;

          if (e.shiftKey || key === 'Shift') {
            if (state.mode === 'playing' && state.phase === 'shuffle') {
              setOverdriveState(true);
            }
          }

          if (e.repeat) return;

          if (state.mode === 'title') {
            if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') {
              e.preventDefault();
              startNewGame();
            }
            return;
          }

          if (state.mode === 'gameover') {
            if (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ') {
              e.preventDefault();
              startNewGame();
            }
            return;
          }

          if (key === 'Escape' || key === 'p' || key === 'P') {
            e.preventDefault();
            togglePause();
            return;
          }

          if (key === 'm' || key === 'M') {
            e.preventDefault();
            const isMuted = audio.toggleMute();
            iconSoundOn.style.display = isMuted ? 'none' : 'block';
            iconSoundOff.style.display = isMuted ? 'block' : 'none';
            return;
          }

          if (key === 'r' || key === 'R') {
            e.preventDefault();
            startNewGame();
          }
        });

        window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Shift') {
            setOverdriveState(false);
          }

        perkBtnSurge.addEventListener('click', () => applyPerkChoice('surge'));
        perkBtnCalm.addEventListener('click', () => applyPerkChoice('calm'));

        function easeInOutCubic(t) {
          return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;
        }

        function easeOutCubic(t) {
          return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
        }

        function evaluateQuadraticBezier(startX, startY, cpX, cpY, endX, endY, t) {
          const inv = 1 - t;
          return {
            x: inv * inv * startX + 2 * inv * t * cpX + t * t * endX,
            y: inv * inv * startY + 2 * inv * t * cpY + t * t * endY,
          };
        }

        function enforceCapsuleSeparation(shellA, shellB) {
          const R = getCapsuleRadius();
          const minSep = R * 2.04;

          const abDx = shellB.x - shellA.x;
          const abDy = shellB.y - shellA.y;
          const abDist = Math.hypot(abDx, abDy) || 1;
          if (abDist < minSep) {
            const push = (minSep - abDist) * 0.5;
            const nx = abDx / abDist;
            const ny = abDy / abDist;
            shellA.x -= nx * push;
            shellA.y -= ny * push;
            shellB.x += nx * push;
            shellB.y += ny * push;
          }

          for (const other of state.shells) {
            if (other.id === shellA.id || other.id === shellB.id) continue;
            for (const moving of [shellA, shellB]) {
              const dx = moving.x - other.x;
              const dy = moving.y - other.y;
              const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
              if (dist < minSep) {
                const push = minSep - dist;
                moving.x += (dx / dist) * push;
                moving.y += (dy / dist) * push;
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // --- Simulation Update Loop ---
        function updateSimulation(dtSeconds) {
          if (Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track')) && Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isComplete?.('ball-track'))) return;
          if (state.mode === 'playing' && !window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track')) {
            state.runTimeSec = Math.max(0, state.runTimeSec - dtSeconds);
            syncRunTime();
            if (state.runTimeSec <= 0) { endTimedRun(); return; }
          }
          const realDtMs = dtSeconds * 1000;
          let dtMs = realDtMs;

          if (state.mode === 'playing' && state.phase === 'shuffle' && state.isOverdrive) {
            dtMs *= 1.8;
            state.overdriveHeldDurationMs += realDtMs;
            state.overdriveMultiplier = calculateOverdriveMultiplier(state.overdriveHeldDurationMs);
            hudOverdriveMultEl.textContent = `${state.overdriveMultiplier.toFixed(1)}x`;
          }

          // Orbital Rotation Updates strictly during Shuffle Phase (after GO!)
          if (state.mode === 'playing' && state.phase === 'shuffle') {
            const rotFactor = state.isOverdrive ? 1.8 : 1.0;
            if (state.config.isDualRing) {
              state.innerRingAngle += state.config.innerRingSpeedRad * rotFactor * dtSeconds;
              state.outerRingAngle += state.config.outerRingSpeedRad * rotFactor * dtSeconds;
            } else if (state.config.hasBoardRotation) {
              state.boardRotationAngle += state.config.boardRotationSpeedRad * rotFactor * dtSeconds;
            }
          }

          state.trauma = Math.max(0, state.trauma - dtSeconds * 1.8);

          // Particles
          for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
            const p = particlePool[i];
            if (!p.active) continue;
            p.life -= dtSeconds;
            if (p.life <= 0) {
              p.active = false;
              continue;
            }
            if (p.kind === 'ring') {
              p.size += dtSeconds * 210;
            } else {
              p.x += p.vx * dtSeconds;
              p.y += p.vy * dtSeconds;
              p.vx *= 0.94;
              p.vy *= 0.94;
              p.rotation += p.vRot * dtSeconds;
            }
            p.alpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
          }

          // Floating Popups
          for (let i = floatingPopups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const pop = floatingPopups[i];
            pop.life -= dtSeconds;
            pop.y -= dtSeconds * 34;
            if (pop.life <= 0) {
              floatingPopups.splice(i, 1);
            }
          }

          if (state.hitstopMs > 0) {
            state.hitstopMs = Math.max(0, state.hitstopMs - realDtMs);
            return;
          }

          if (state.mode === 'title') {
            const slots = computeLiveSlotCoordinates();
            for (let i = 0; i < state.shells.length; i++) {
              const s = state.shells[i];
              s.x = slots[i].x;
              s.y = slots[i].y;
              s.shieldOpen = i === 0 ? 1 : 0;
            }
            return;
          }

          if (state.mode !== 'playing') return;

          const liveSlots = computeLiveSlotCoordinates();
          const lineupCoords = computeTargetLineupPositions(state.config.targetCount);

          for (const s of state.shells) {
            s.scaleX += (1 - s.scaleX) * Math.min(1, dtSeconds * 14);
            s.scaleY += (1 - s.scaleY) * Math.min(1, dtSeconds * 14);
            s.flash = Math.max(0, s.flash - dtSeconds * 4.5);

            const slot = liveSlots[s.slotIndex] || liveSlots[0];
            s.baseX = slot.x;
            s.baseY = slot.y;
            s.ring = slot.ring;

            if (s.hasCore && typeof s.targetOrder === 'number' && lineupCoords[s.targetOrder]) {
              s.lineupX = lineupCoords[s.targetOrder].x;
              s.lineupY = lineupCoords[s.targetOrder].y;
            }

            const targetOpen =
              ((state.phase === 'lineup' || state.phase === 'wave_ready') && s.hasCore) ||
              (state.phase === 'insert' && s.hasCore && state.phaseElapsedMs < state.phaseDurationMs * 0.72) ||
              s.revealedState === 'correct' ||
              s.revealedState === 'wrong' ||
              s.revealedState === 'missed'
                ? 1
                : 0;
            s.shieldOpen += (targetOpen - s.shieldOpen) * Math.min(1, dtSeconds * 14);

            if (state.phase === 'lineup' || state.phase === 'wave_ready') {
              if (s.hasCore) {
                s.x = s.lineupX;
                s.y = s.lineupY;
              } else {
                s.x = slot.x;
                s.y = slot.y;
              }
              s.trail.length = 0;
            } else if (state.phase === 'insert') {
              if (s.hasCore) {
                const rawInsertT = Math.min(1, state.phaseElapsedMs / Math.max(1, state.phaseDurationMs));
                const t = easeInOutCubic(rawInsertT);
                const cpx = (s.lineupX + slot.x) * 0.5 - 34;
                const cpy = (s.lineupY + slot.y) * 0.5 - 16;
                const pos = evaluateQuadraticBezier(s.lineupX, s.lineupY, cpx, cpy, slot.x, slot.y, t);
                s.x = pos.x;
                s.y = pos.y;
                s.trail.unshift({ x: s.x, y: s.y });
                if (s.trail.length > 9) s.trail.pop();
              } else {
                s.x = slot.x;
                s.y = slot.y;
                s.trail.length = 0;
              }
            } else {
              const isSwapping =
                state.phase === 'shuffle' &&
                state.activeSwap &&
                (state.activeSwap.shellA.id === s.id || state.activeSwap.shellB.id === s.id);

              if (!isSwapping) {
                s.x = slot.x;
                s.y = slot.y;
                if (s.trail.length > 0) {
                  s.trail.length = 0;
                }
              } else {
                s.trail.unshift({ x: s.x, y: s.y });
                if (s.trail.length > 10) s.trail.pop();

                if (state.isOverdrive && Math.random() < 0.3) {
                  spawnParticle(
                    s.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
                    s.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
                    (Math.random() - 0.5) * 48,
                    (Math.random() - 0.5) * 48,
                    2 + Math.random() * 2,
                    0.2,
                    '#ffedd5',
                    'spark'
                  );
                }
              }
            }
          }

          if (!(Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('ball-track')) && state.phase === 'select')) state.phaseElapsedMs += dtMs;

          if (state.phase === 'wave_ready') {
            if (state.phaseElapsedMs >= state.phaseDurationMs) {
              enterLineupPhase();
            }
          } else if (state.phase === 'lineup') {
            // 1.2s top-right TARGET lineup (Timer strictly FROZEN)
            if (state.phaseElapsedMs >= state.phaseDurationMs) {
              state.phaseElapsedMs = 0;
              state.phaseDurationMs = state.config.insertDurationMs;
              setBodyState('playing', 'insert');
              setFrozenTimerHud('INSERTING TARGETS', '#38bdf8');
            }
          } else if (state.phase === 'insert') {
            // Smooth Bezier glide from top-right TARGET lineup into circular orbit slots (Timer strictly FROZEN)
            if (state.phaseElapsedMs >= state.phaseDurationMs) {
              for (const s of state.shells) {
                s.x = s.baseX;
                s.y = s.baseY;
                s.shieldOpen = 0;
                s.trail.length = 0;
                if (s.hasCore) {
                  s.scaleX = 1.08;
                  s.scaleY = 0.92;
                  s.flash = 0;
                }
              }
              audio.playCoreLockLatch();
              // Show "READY" in the center for 0.6s with steady mid tone (Timer strictly FROZEN)
              waveBannerTitleEl.textContent = 'READY';
              state.phaseElapsedMs = 0;
              state.phaseDurationMs = state.config.readyDurationMs;
              setBodyState('playing', 'ready_banner');
              setFrozenTimerHud('READY', '#38bdf8');
              audio.playReadyChime();
            }
          } else if (state.phase === 'ready_banner') {
            // "READY" (0.6s) -> Flash "GO!" (0.4s) in the center in vibrant yellow with ascending tone
            if (state.phaseElapsedMs >= state.phaseDurationMs) {
              waveBannerTitleEl.textContent = 'GO!';
              state.phaseElapsedMs = 0;
              state.phaseDurationMs = state.config.goDurationMs;
              setBodyState('playing', 'go_banner');
              hudPhaseTextEl.textContent = 'GO!';
              hudPhaseTextEl.style.color = '#facc15';
              hudGaugeFillEl.style.backgroundColor = '#facc15';
              audio.playGoTone();
            }
          } else if (state.phase === 'go_banner') {
            // Timer starts ticking upon "GO!"
            const goRatio = Math.max(0, 1 - (state.phaseElapsedMs / Math.max(1, state.phaseDurationMs)) * 0.08);
            hudGaugeFillEl.style.transform = `scaleX(${goRatio.toFixed(3)})`;
            if (state.phaseElapsedMs >= state.phaseDurationMs) {
              setBodyState('playing', 'shuffle');
              hudPhaseTextEl.textContent = state.config.isDualRing
                ? 'DUAL RINGS · TRACK'
                : state.config.hasBoardRotation
                  ? 'ORBIT SPIN · TRACK'
                  : 'TRACK MOVEMENT';
              hudPhaseTextEl.style.color = '#38bdf8';
              hudGaugeFillEl.style.backgroundColor = '#22d3ee';
              state.currentSwapIndex = 0;
              beginShuffleStep(0);
            }
          } else if (state.phase === 'shuffle') {
            const active = state.activeSwap;
            if (!active) {
              beginShuffleStep(state.currentSwapIndex);
              return;
            }

            state.swapElapsedMs += dtMs;
            const rawT = Math.min(1, state.swapElapsedMs / Math.max(1, active.durationMs));
            const t = active.isDecelerationStep ? easeOutCubic(rawT) : easeInOutCubic(rawT);

            const startA = liveSlots[active.fromSlotA] || liveSlots[0];
            const endA = liveSlots[active.toSlotA] || liveSlots[0];
            const startB = liveSlots[active.fromSlotB] || liveSlots[0];
            const endB = liveSlots[active.toSlotB] || liveSlots[0];

            const midX = (startA.x + endA.x) * 0.5;
            const midY = (startA.y + endA.y) * 0.5;
            const dx = endA.x - startA.x;
            const dy = endA.y - startA.y;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
            const nx = -dy / dist;
            const ny = dx / dist;

            const isWide = active.curve === 'bezier_wide_cw' || active.curve === 'bezier_wide_ccw';
            const dir = active.curve.endsWith('_ccw') ? -1 : 1;
            const bowHeight = active.isRadialHop
              ? Math.max(54, Math.min(105, dist * 0.38))
              : isWide
                ? Math.max(85, Math.min(155, dist * 0.48))
                : Math.max(70, Math.min(130, dist * 0.42));

            const cpAX = midX + dir * nx * bowHeight;
            const cpAY = midY + dir * ny * bowHeight;
            const cpBX = midX - dir * nx * bowHeight;
            const cpBY = midY - dir * ny * bowHeight;

            active.liveCurve = {
              startAX: startA.x,
              startAY: startA.y,
              endAX: endA.x,
              endAY: endA.y,
              cpAX,
              cpAY,
              startBX: startB.x,
              startBY: startB.y,
              endBX: endB.x,
              endBY: endB.y,
              cpBX,
              cpBY,
            };

            const posA = evaluateQuadraticBezier(
              startA.x,
              startA.y,
              cpAX,
              cpAY,
              endA.x,
              endA.y,
              t
            );
            const posB = evaluateQuadraticBezier(
              startB.x,
              startB.y,
              cpBX,
              cpBY,
              endB.x,
              endB.y,
              t
            );

            active.shellA.x = posA.x;
            active.shellA.y = posA.y;
            active.shellB.x = posB.x;
            active.shellB.y = posB.y;

            if (rawT > 0.05 && rawT < 0.95) {
              enforceCapsuleSeparation(active.shellA, active.shellB);
            }

            const totalProgress =
              (state.currentSwapIndex + rawT) / Math.max(1, state.swapSchedule.length);
            hudGaugeFillEl.style.transform = `scaleX(${(1 - totalProgress).toFixed(3)})`;
            syncRunTime();

            if (rawT >= 1) {
              active.shellA.x = endA.x;
              active.shellA.y = endA.y;
              active.shellB.x = endB.x;
              active.shellB.y = endB.y;
              active.shellA.trail.length = 0;
              active.shellB.trail.length = 0;
              state.currentSwapIndex += 1;
              beginShuffleStep(state.currentSwapIndex);
            }
          } else if (state.phase === 'select') {
            const rem = Math.max(0, state.phaseDurationMs - state.phaseElapsedMs);
            syncRunTime();
            hudGaugeFillEl.style.transform = `scaleX(${(state.runTimeSec / 60).toFixed(3)})`;

            const liveMult = calculateSpeedMultiplier(
              rem,
              state.phaseDurationMs,
              state.streak + 1
            );
            hudMultEl.textContent = liveMult.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'x';


          } else if (state.phase === 'wave_clear') {
            if (state.phaseElapsedMs >= state.phaseDurationMs) {
              if (checkMilestonePerkTrigger(state.wave)) {
                return;
              }
              initWave(state.wave + 1, true);
            }
          } else if (state.phase === 'resolve') {
            if (state.phaseElapsedMs >= state.phaseDurationMs) {
              const pickedCount = state.shells.filter((s) => s.hasCore && s.picked).length;
              const nextWave = pickedCount >= 1 ? state.wave + 1 : state.wave;
              initWave(nextWave, true);
            }
          } else if (state.phase === 'defeat_beat') {
            if (state.phaseElapsedMs >= state.phaseDurationMs) {
              showGameOverModal();
            }
          }
        }

        // --- Canvas 2D Renderer (Strict 1:1 Circular Orbits + Top-Right "TARGET" Queue) ---
        function drawArenaBackground() {
          const { cx, cy, innerRadius, outerRadius } = getPlayboardGeometry();
          const maxSpan = Math.max(viewportWidth, viewportHeight) * 1.6;

          const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 10, cx, cy, outerRadius * 1.45);
          grad.addColorStop(0, '#c5ded4');
          grad.addColorStop(0.6, '#d8e7d8');
          grad.addColorStop(1, '#f0ecd9');
          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.fillRect(cx - maxSpan * 0.5, cy - maxSpan * 0.5, maxSpan, maxSpan);

          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(cx, cy);

          // Outer Strict 1:1 Circular Orbit Ring
          ctx.strokeStyle = state.isOverdrive ? 'rgba(255, 120, 73, 0.28)' : 'rgba(77, 116, 86, 0.35)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 0, outerRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();

          // Inner Strict 1:1 Circular Orbit Ring (Visible in Dual Concentric Waves 10+)
          if (state.mode !== 'title' && state.config && state.config.isDualRing) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = state.isOverdrive ? 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.32)' : 'rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.26)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, innerRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
          }

          ctx.restore();

          if (state.mode !== 'title') {
            const slots = computeLiveSlotCoordinates();
            const R = getCapsuleRadius();
            const slotR = R + 5;
            for (let i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) {
              const shellAtSlot = state.shells.find((s) => s.slotIndex === i);
              const isPendingTargetSlot =
                (state.phase === 'lineup' || state.phase === 'insert' || state.phase === 'wave_ready') &&
                shellAtSlot &&
                shellAtSlot.hasCore;

              ctx.save();
              if (isPendingTargetSlot) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.45)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
                ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
              } else {
                ctx.strokeStyle = slots[i].ring === 'inner'
                  ? 'rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.18)'
                  : 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
              }
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(slots[i].x, slots[i].y, slotR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.restore();
            }
          }
        }

        // Top-Right "TARGET" Vertical Lineup Queue Panel during Inspection & Insertion
        function drawTargetLineupPanel() {
          if (state.mode !== 'playing') return;
          if (state.phase !== 'lineup' && state.phase !== 'insert' && state.phase !== 'wave_ready') return;

          const { queueX, panelW, isMobile } = getPlayboardGeometry();
          const targetCount = state.config.targetCount;
          const lineupCoords = computeTargetLineupPositions(targetCount);
          const R = getCapsuleRadius();

          const fadeAlpha =
            state.phase === 'insert'
              ? Math.max(0, 1 - state.phaseElapsedMs / Math.max(1, state.phaseDurationMs * 0.9))
              : 1;

          const topY = lineupCoords[0].y - R - (isMobile ? 30 : 36);
          const bottomY = lineupCoords[lineupCoords.length - 1].y + R + 14;
          const panelH = Math.max(82, bottomY - topY);
          const panelX = Math.min(viewportWidth - panelW - 6, queueX - panelW * 0.5);

          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha = fadeAlpha;

          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 14, 26, 0.92)';
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.48)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(panelX, topY, panelW, panelH, 10);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.stroke();

          // Exact required container label: "TARGET"
          ctx.font = isMobile ? '800 10px "Outfit", sans-serif' : '800 12px "Outfit", sans-serif';
          ctx.fillStyle = '#22d3ee';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('TARGET', panelX + panelW * 0.5, topY + 20);

          // Draw queue cradle rings & curved Bezier insertion preview arcs
          for (let i = 0; i < lineupCoords.length; i++) {
            const pt = lineupCoords[i];
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.28)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, R + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
          }

          for (const s of state.shells) {
            if (!s.hasCore) continue;
            const cpx = (s.lineupX + s.baseX) * 0.5 - 34;
            const cpy = (s.lineupY + s.baseY) * 0.5 - 16;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.strokeStyle = state.phase === 'insert'
              ? 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.42)'
              : 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.18)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
            ctx.setLineDash([4, 5]);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(s.lineupX, s.lineupY);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cpx, cpy, s.baseX, s.baseY);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.restore();
          }

          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Draw Trajectory Arcs & Ease-Out Deceleration Cues
        function drawTrajectoryArcs() {
          if (state.mode !== 'playing' || state.phase !== 'shuffle' || !state.activeSwap) return;
          const active = state.activeSwap;
          if (!active.liveCurve) return;
          const lc = active.liveCurve;

          const baseAlpha = active.isDecelerationStep ? 0.28 : 0.15;
          const colorA = state.isOverdrive
            ? `rgba(255, 120, 73, ${baseAlpha})`
            : active.isRadialHop
              ? `rgba(20, 184, 166, ${baseAlpha + 0.08})`
              : `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${baseAlpha})`;

          ctx.save();
          ctx.lineWidth = active.isDecelerationStep ? 2.2 : 1.5;
          ctx.setLineDash([5, 6]);

          ctx.strokeStyle = colorA;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(lc.startAX, lc.startAY);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(lc.cpAX, lc.cpAY, lc.endAX, lc.endAY);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(lc.startBX, lc.startBY);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(lc.cpBX, lc.cpBY, lc.endBX, lc.endBY);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.setLineDash([]);
          if (active.isDecelerationStep) {
            const R = getCapsuleRadius();
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.35)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(lc.endAX, lc.endAY, R + 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(lc.endBX, lc.endBY, R + 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Render Motion Trails ONLY on the two actively swapping capsules (zero smearing)
        function drawShellTrail(shell) {
          if (shell.trail.length < 2) return;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

          const trailRGB = state.isOverdrive ? '255, 120, 73' : '34, 211, 238';
          const R = getCapsuleRadius();
          for (let i = 0; i < shell.trail.length - 1; i++) {

            ctx.moveTo(p0.x, p0.y);
            ctx.lineTo(p1.x, p1.y);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }

        function drawShellCapsule(shell, timeSec) {
          const R = getCapsuleRadius();
          // Covered leaves have identical paint, veins and orientation regardless of contents.
          // Residual shutter animation must never disclose identity in shuffle/select.
          const revealPhase = state.mode === 'title' || ['lineup', 'wave_ready', 'insert'].includes(state.phase);
          const revealed = shell.revealedState === 'correct' || shell.revealedState === 'missed';
          const visibleOtter = shell.hasCore && shell.shieldOpen > 0.15 && (revealPhase || revealed);
          ctx.save();ctx.translate(shell.x, shell.y);ctx.scale(shell.scaleX, shell.scaleY);

          ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,R*.22,R*1.08,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#88a979';ctx.strokeStyle = '#4d7456';ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-R*.9,R*.55);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-R*1.25,-R*.8,R*.72,-R*.88);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(R*1.25,R*.68,-R*.9,R*.55);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#c2cda1';ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
          ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-R*.72,R*.42);ctx.lineTo(R*.58,-R*.68);
          for(let i=0;i<3;i++) {
            const v=-R*.35+i*R*.28;
            ctx.moveTo(v,-v*.8);ctx.lineTo(v-R*.28,-v*.8-R*.28);
            ctx.moveTo(v,-v*.8);ctx.lineTo(v+R*.3,-v*.8+R*.18);
          }
          ctx.stroke();
          if(visibleOtter) {
            ctx.fillStyle='#e6edcd';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,R*.72,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
            if(window.ToenowAnimals && window.ToenowAnimals.drawAnimal) {
              window.ToenowAnimals.drawAnimal(ctx,'otter',0,0,R*1.35);
            } else {
              ctx.fillStyle='#956d4c';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,R*.48,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
              ctx.fillStyle='#f0dfba';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,R*.15,R*.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
              ctx.fillStyle='#382f27';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-R*.18,-R*.08,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.arc(R*.18,-R*.08,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

            ctx.strokeStyle='#a34f42';ctx.lineWidth=3;

            ctx.moveTo(R*.23,-R*.23);ctx.lineTo(-R*.23,R*.23);ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }

        function drawParticlesAndPopups() {
          for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
            const p = particlePool[i];
            if (!p.active) continue;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
            if (p.kind === 'ring') {
              ctx.strokeStyle = p.color;
              ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.stroke();
            } else if (p.kind === 'shard') {
              ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
              ctx.rotate(p.rotation);
              ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(0, -p.size);
              ctx.lineTo(p.size * 0.75, p.size);
              ctx.lineTo(-p.size * 0.75, p.size);
              ctx.closePath();
              ctx.fill();
            } else {
              ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.fill();
            }
            ctx.restore();
          }

          for (const pop of floatingPopups) {
            const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pop.life / pop.maxLife));
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.font = '800 18px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
            ctx.fillStyle = pop.color;
            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85)';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
            ctx.fillText(pop.text, pop.x, pop.y);

            if (pop.subtext) {

              ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
              ctx.fillText(pop.subtext, pop.x, pop.y + 14);
            }
            ctx.restore();

        }

        function renderScene(timeSec) {
          // Complete frame wipe every tick to guarantee zero smearing or ghosting
          ctx.clearRect(0, 0, viewportWidth, viewportHeight);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a12';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewportWidth, viewportHeight);

          ctx.save();
          if (state.trauma > 0.001) {
            const shake = state.trauma * state.trauma * 10;
            const ox = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * shake;
            const oy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * shake;
            ctx.translate(ox, oy);
          }

          drawArenaBackground();
          drawTargetLineupPanel();
          drawTrajectoryArcs();

          for (const s of state.shells) {
            drawShellTrail(s);
          }
          for (const s of state.shells) {

          }

          drawParticlesAndPopups();
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // --- Main 60 FPS Animation Loop ---
        let lastFrameTime = performance.now();
        function frameLoop(now) {
          const dtSeconds = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0.001, (now - lastFrameTime) / 1000));
          lastFrameTime = now;

          updateSimulation(dtSeconds);
          renderScene(now / 1000);

          requestAnimationFrame(frameLoop);
        }

        // --- Deterministic Test & Verification Hooks ---
        window.__QUANTUM_SHELL__ = {
          getState: () => ({
            mode: state.mode,
            phase: state.phase,
            wave: state.wave,
            tier: state.config.tier,
            tierName: state.config.tierName,
            isDualRing: state.config.isDualRing,
            innerRingCount: state.config.innerRingCount,

            runTimeSec: state.runTimeSec,
            mistakesThisWave: state.mistakesThisWave,
            perkDoubleSurge: state.perkDoubleSurge,
            perkCalmDriftCount: state.perkCalmDriftCount,
            isOverdrive: state.isOverdrive,
            overdriveMultiplier: state.overdriveMultiplier,
            targetCount: state.config.targetCount,
            shellCount: state.config.shellCount,
            shells: state.shells.map((s) => ({
              id: s.id,
              slotIndex: s.slotIndex,
              ring: s.ring,
              hasCore: s.hasCore,
              targetOrder: s.targetOrder,
              picked: s.picked,
              x: s.x,
              y: s.y,
              lineupX: s.lineupX,
              lineupY: s.lineupY,
              revealedState: s.revealedState,
            })),
          }),
          startNewGame,
          jumpToWave: (waveNum) => {
            initWave(waveNum, false);
          },
          openPerkModalForWave: (clearedWave) => {
            checkMilestonePerkTrigger(clearedWave);
          },
          setOverdrive: (active) => {
            setOverdriveState(active);
          },
          forceSelectPhase: () => {
            if (state.mode === 'playing') {
              beginShuffleStep(state.swapSchedule.length);
            }
          },
          pickShellById: (id) => {
            const target = state.shells.find((s) => s.id === id);
            if (target) handleShellSelection(target);
          },
        };

        window.ToenowTutorials?.register?.('ball-track', {
          start() { startNewGame(1, true); },
          stop() { state.isPractice = false; returnToTitle(); },
          getGuide() {
            if (state.phase !== 'select') return { prompt: 'Remember the otter, then follow its leaf.', rect: null, waiting: true };
            const target = state.shells.find(s => s.hasCore && !s.picked) || state.shells.find(s => s.hasCore);
            const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), radius = getCapsuleRadius();
            return { prompt: 'Tap the leaf hiding the otter.', rect: target ? { x: bounds.left + target.x - radius, y: bounds.top + target.y - radius, width: radius * 2, height: radius * 2 } : null, done: Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isComplete?.('ball-track')) };
          }
        });

        // Initialize
        resizeCanvas();
        createTitleShowcaseShells();
        updateHudReadouts();

        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (typeof ToenowLevels !== 'undefined' && ToenowLevels.setupPracticeMode) {

            container: '#screen-title .unified-title-card',
            onStartGame: (startWave, isPractice) => {
              startNewGame(startWave, isPractice);
            }
          });
        }

        if (params.get('autostart') === '1') {
          startNewGame();
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(frameLoop);
      })();
    </script>

        function createRng(seed) {
          let a = seed >>> 0;
          return function () {
            a |= 0;
            a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
            let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
            t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
            return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
          };
        }

        function shuffleArray(items, rng) {
          const arr = items.slice();
          for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
            const tmp = arr[i];
            arr[i] = arr[j];
            arr[j] = tmp;
          }
          return arr;
        }

        function getWaveDurationSec(w) {
          const t = 3.5 + 4.5 * Math.exp(-0.07 * Math.max(0, w - 1));
          return Number(t.toFixed(1));

        // 5-Level System Mapping
        function getLevelForWave(wave) {
          if (wave <= 5) return 1;  // Level 1 (Beginner): Waves 1-5
          if (wave <= 10) return 2; // Level 2 (Intermediate): Waves 6-10
          if (wave <= 15) return 3; // Level 3 (Advanced): Waves 11-15
          if (wave <= 20) return 4; // Level 4 (Expert): Waves 16-20
          return 5;                 // Level 5 (Master): Waves 21+
        }

        // Progressive Time Bonuses:
        // Level 1: Base duration (+0s)
        // Level 2: Level 1 + 1s (+1.0s)
        // Level 3: Level 2 + 2s (+3.0s)
        // Level 4: Level 3 + 3s (+6.0s)
        // Level 5: Level 4 + 4s (+10.0s)
        function getLevelTimeBonusSec(level) {
          if (level <= 1) return 0;
          if (level === 2) return 1.0;
          if (level === 3) return 3.0; // Level 2 time + 2s
          if (level === 4) return 6.0; // Level 3 time + 3s
          return 10.0; // Level 5 (Level 4 time + 4s)
        }

        function calculateWaveDuration(wave, level) {
          const base = getWaveDurationSec(wave);
          const bonus = getLevelTimeBonusSec(level);
          return Number((base + bonus).toFixed(1));
        }

        function computeTorqueTiltAngle(leftTorque, rightTorque) {
          const diff = rightTorque - leftTorque;
          if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.001) return 0;
          const maxTilt = 0.27;
          const minTilt = 0.14;
          const normalized = Math.min(1, Math.abs(diff) / 80);
          const magnitude = minTilt + (maxTilt - minTilt) * normalized;
          return diff > 0 ? magnitude : -magnitude;
        }

        // Overhauled Puzzle Generation Structured Across 5 Distinct Levels
        function generateOverhauledPuzzle(wave, seed) {
          const rng = createRng((seed || Date.now()) + wave * 9173);
          const level = getLevelForWave(wave);

          let scaleCount = 1;
          let bodyCount = 2;

          if (level === 1) {
            // Level 1: 1 or 2 comparisons (equal arms only)
            scaleCount = wave <= 2 ? 1 : 2;
            bodyCount = scaleCount === 1 ? 2 : 3;
          } else if (level === 2) {
            // Level 2: 2 comparisons with asymmetric arm
            scaleCount = 2;
            bodyCount = 3;
          } else if (level === 3) {
            // Level 3: 3 comparisons with asymmetric arm
            scaleCount = 3;
            bodyCount = 4;
          } else if (level === 4) {
            // Level 4: 4 comparisons with asymmetric arm
            scaleCount = 4;
            bodyCount = 5;
          } else {
            // Level 5: 5 or 6 comparisons with asymmetric arm
            scaleCount = wave <= 14 ? 5 : 6;
            bodyCount = 6;
          }

          const duration = calculateWaveDuration(wave, level);

          // Randomize Directive (middle weight / median ONLY allowed when bodyCount is an odd number)
          let directive = 'max';
          if (bodyCount % 2 === 0) {
            // Even number of bodies (2, 4, 6): No unique middle element -> only max or min
            directive = rng() < 0.5 ? 'max' : 'min';
          } else {
            // Odd number of bodies (3, 5): Has an exact unique middle element
            const roll = rng();
            if (roll < 0.34) directive = 'max';
            else if (roll < 0.67) directive = 'min';
            else directive = 'median';
          }

          let directiveTitle = 'IDENTIFY MAXIMUM MASS';
          let directiveSub = 'TAP THE HEAVIEST CELESTIAL ENTITY';
          if (directive === 'min') {
            directiveTitle = 'IDENTIFY MINIMUM MASS';
            directiveSub = 'TAP THE LIGHTEST CELESTIAL ENTITY';
          } else if (directive === 'median') {
            directiveTitle = 'IDENTIFY MEDIAN MASS';
            directiveSub = 'TAP THE BALANCED MIDDLE ENTITY';
          }

          let massesByRank = [];
          if (bodyCount === 2) {
            massesByRank = [100, 50];
          } else if (bodyCount === 3) {
            massesByRank = [160, 90, 35]; // r1(90) on 1x (torque 90) > r2(35) on 2x (torque 70)
          } else if (bodyCount === 4) {
            massesByRank = [180, 110, 65, 25]; // r2(65) on 1x > r3(25) on 2x
          } else if (bodyCount === 5) {
            massesByRank = [220, 150, 95, 55, 20]; // r3(55) on 1x > r4(20) on 2x
          } else {
            massesByRank = [260, 190, 130, 85, 50, 20]; // r4(50) on 1x > r5(20) on 2x
          }

          const shuffledArchetypes = shuffleArray(ARCHETYPES, rng);
          const stroopTrick = rng() < 0.55;
          const rankOrder = shuffleArray(Array.from({ length: bodyCount }, (_, i) => i), rng);

          const usedArchIds = new Set();
          const bodies = rankOrder.map((rank, desIdx) => {
            const des = GREEK_NAMES[desIdx];
            let arch = null;

            if (stroopTrick) {
              if (rank === 0) {
                const cand = rng() < 0.5 ? ARCHETYPES[0] : ARCHETYPES[1];
                if (!usedArchIds.has(cand.id)) arch = cand;
              } else if (rank === bodyCount - 1) {
                const cand = rng() < 0.5 ? ARCHETYPES[4] : ARCHETYPES[5];
                if (!usedArchIds.has(cand.id)) arch = cand;
              }
            }

            if (!arch) {
              arch =
                shuffledArchetypes.find((a) => !usedArchIds.has(a.id)) ||
                shuffledArchetypes[desIdx % shuffledArchetypes.length];
            }
            usedArchIds.add(arch.id);

            const radius =
              arch.minRadius + Math.floor(rng() * (arch.maxRadius - arch.minRadius + 1));

            return {
              id: des.id,
              label: des.label,
              symbol: des.symbol,
              keyIndex: desIdx + 1,
              archetype: arch.id,
              archetypeName: arch.name,
              densityDesc: arch.densityDesc,
              mass: massesByRank[rank],
              visualRadius: radius,
              primaryColor: arch.primaryColor,
              secondaryColor: arch.secondaryColor,
              coreColor: arch.coreColor,
            };
          });

          const getBodyByRank = (r) => bodies[rankOrder.indexOf(r)];

          let targetRank = 0;
          if (directive === 'max') targetRank = 0;
          else if (directive === 'min') targetRank = bodyCount - 1;
          else targetRank = Math.floor(bodyCount / 2);

          const targetBodyId = getBodyByRank(targetRank).id;

          const scales = [];
          const makeScaleObj = (id, type, leftItems, rightItems, leftDist, rightDist, equality) => {
            const lTorque = leftItems.reduce((s, it) => s + it.mass, 0) * leftDist;
            const rTorque = rightItems.reduce((s, it) => s + it.mass, 0) * rightDist;
            return {
              id,
              type,
              leftItems,
              rightItems,
              leftDistance: leftDist,
              rightDistance: rightDist,
              leftTorque: lTorque,
              rightTorque: rTorque,
              targetAngle: equality ? 0 : computeTorqueTiltAngle(lTorque, rTorque),
              currentAngle: 0,
              angularVel: 0,
              settled: false,
              equality,
            };
          };

          const makeSimple = (id, a, b) => {
            const flip = rng() < 0.5;
            const left = flip ? b : a;
            const right = flip ? a : b;
            return makeScaleObj(
              id,
              'simple',
              [{ type: 'body', id: left.id, bodyId: left.id, mass: left.mass }],
              [{ type: 'body', id: right.id, bodyId: right.id, mass: right.mass }],
              1.0,
              1.0,
              false
            );
          };

          const makeLever = (id, shortBody, longBody, sDist = 1.0, lDist = 2.0) => {
            const flip = rng() < 0.5;
            const left = flip ? longBody : shortBody;
            const right = flip ? shortBody : longBody;
            const leftD = flip ? lDist : sDist;
            const rightD = flip ? sDist : lDist;
            return makeScaleObj(
              id,
              'lever_asymmetric',
              [{ type: 'body', id: left.id, bodyId: left.id, mass: left.mass }],
              [{ type: 'body', id: right.id, bodyId: right.id, mass: right.mass }],
              leftD,
              rightD,
              false
            );
          };

          const r0 = getBodyByRank(0);
          const r1 = getBodyByRank(1);
          const r2 = bodyCount >= 3 ? getBodyByRank(2) : null;
          const r3 = bodyCount >= 4 ? getBodyByRank(3) : null;
          const r4 = bodyCount >= 5 ? getBodyByRank(4) : null;
          const r5 = bodyCount >= 6 ? getBodyByRank(5) : null;

          if (level === 1) {
            // Level 1: 1 or 2 comparisons, equal arms ONLY (arm 一样)
            if (scaleCount === 1) {
              scales.push(makeSimple('scale-1', r0, r1));
            } else if (r2) {
              scales.push(makeSimple('scale-1', r0, r1), makeSimple('scale-2', r1, r2));
            }
          } else if (level === 2 && r2) {
            // Level 2: 2 comparisons, with asymmetric arm (arm 不一样: 1× vs 2×)
            // r1 on 1× arm tilts down over r2 on 2× arm (torque 90 > 70)
            scales.push(makeLever('scale-1', r1, r2, 1.0, 2.0));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-2', r0, r1));
          } else if (level === 3 && r2 && r3) {
            // Level 3: 3 comparisons, with asymmetric arm
            scales.push(makeLever('scale-1', r2, r3, 1.0, 2.0));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-2', r0, r1));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-3', r1, r2));
          } else if (level === 4 && r2 && r3 && r4) {
            // Level 4: 4 comparisons, with asymmetric arm
            scales.push(makeLever('scale-1', r3, r4, 1.0, 2.0));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-2', r0, r1));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-3', r1, r2));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-4', r2, r3));
          } else if (level === 5 && r2 && r3 && r4 && r5) {
            // Level 5: 5 or 6 comparisons, with asymmetric arm
            scales.push(makeLever('scale-1', r4, r5, 1.0, 2.0));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-2', r0, r1));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-3', r1, r2));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-4', r2, r3));
            scales.push(makeSimple('scale-5', r3, r4));
            if (scaleCount >= 6) {
              scales.push(makeSimple('scale-6', r0, r2));
            }
          }

          let modeLabel = 'LEVEL 1 · BEGINNER (EQUAL ARMS)';
          if (level === 2) modeLabel = 'LEVEL 2 · INTERMEDIATE (2 SCALES)';
          else if (level === 3) modeLabel = 'LEVEL 3 · ADVANCED (3 SCALES)';
          else if (level === 4) modeLabel = 'LEVEL 4 · EXPERT (4 SCALES)';
          else if (level === 5) modeLabel = 'LEVEL 5 · MASTER (' + scaleCount + ' SCALES)';

          return {
            wave,
            level,
            modeLabel,
            directive,
            directiveTitle,
            directiveSub,
            waveDurationSec: duration,
            bodies,
            scales,
            targetBodyId,
          };
        }

        // Particle pool
        const MAX_PARTICLES = 72;

        function startNewGame(startWave = 1, isPractice = false) {

        function triggerGameOver() {
          if (Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('space-scale'))) return;
          const finalScore = Math.round(score);
          if (!isPracticeMode) {
            const clearedWave = Math.max(1, wave - 1);
            const curBestWave = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('space_scale_best_wave') || '1', 10) || 1;
            if (clearedWave > curBestWave) {
              try {
                localStorage.setItem('space_scale_best_wave', String(clearedWave));
              } catch (_) {}
            }
            if (finalScore > bestScore) {
              bestScore = finalScore;
              try {
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_BEST_SCORE, String(bestScore));
              } catch (_) {}
            }
            syncPersistentStatsUI();
          }
          const levelInfo = ToenowLevels.getLevelInfo(wave);
          ToenowScreens.updateGameOver('space-scale', { score: finalScore, bestScore, wave, combo: peakStreak, reason: 'TIME EXPIRED' });
                    sound.playGameOver();
          setGameState('gameover');

          // Toenow Game SDK Unified Lifecycle & Hub Contract
          if (toenowSdk) {
            toenowSdk.reportGameOver({
              score: finalScore,
              wave: Math.max(1, wave - 1),
              isPractice: isPracticeMode,
              rank: levelInfo.badgeText
            });
          } else {
            try {
              if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) {
                window.parent.postMessage(
                  {
                    type: 'GAME_OVER',
                    gameId: 'space-scale',
                    category: 'logic',
                    score: finalScore,
                    isPractice: Boolean(isPracticeMode),
                    wave: Math.max(1, wave - 1),
                    rank: levelInfo.badgeText

        function handleBodySelection(bodyId, tapX, tapY) {
          if (gameState !== 'playing' || collapseAnim || (Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('space-scale')) && Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isComplete?.('space-scale')))) return;
          if (Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('space-scale'))) {
            if (bodyId === currentPuzzle.targetBodyId) {
              hoveredBodyId = bodyId; syncDockHoverState(); sound.playCollapseSuccess(1);
              window.ToenowTutorials.complete('space-scale');

          }

          const isCorrect = bodyId === currentPuzzle.targetBodyId;
          if (window.ToenowAnimals) window.ToenowAnimals.feedback('space-scale', isCorrect);

          if (isCorrect) {
            globalTimeSec = ToenowTime.correct(globalTimeSec);
            streak++;

            peakStreak = Math.max(peakStreak, streak);
            const tierBase = wave <= 3 ? 120 : wave <= 6 ? 200 : 320;
            const speedRatio = Math.max(0, 1 - waveElapsedSec / currentPuzzle.waveDurationSec);
            const speedBonus = Math.round(speedRatio * 110);
            const streakBonus = Math.min(350, (streak - 1) * 40);
            const earnedScore = tierBase + speedBonus + streakBonus;
            score += earnedScore;

            if (score > bestScore) {
              bestScore = score;
              if (!isPracticeMode) localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_BEST_SCORE, String(bestScore));
            }

            const expGain = Math.round(100 + streak * 30 + speedRatio * 60);
            updateExpUI(totalExp + expGain);

            let targetX = tapX || canvasWidth * 0.5;
            let targetY = tapY || canvasHeight * 0.5;
            const foundTarget = renderedBodyTargets.find((t) => t.bodyId === bodyId);
            if (foundTarget) {
              targetX = foundTarget.x;

            }

            const chosenBody =
              currentPuzzle.bodies.find((b) => b.id === bodyId) || currentPuzzle.bodies[0];

            hitstopTimer = 0.045;

        // Resize handling

        function getCanvasPoint(clientX, clientY) {
