        // Mystery parcel and calibrated counterweight rendering
        function drawMysteryParcel(ctx, body, x, y, time, isHovered, collapseFactor) {
          ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);
          // Display size stays independent of the hidden weight, exactly as before.
          const r=Math.max(6,body.visualRadius*(collapseFactor===undefined?1:collapseFactor));
          ctx.fillStyle='#f2dfb9';ctx.strokeStyle=isHovered?'#ffffff':body.primaryColor;ctx.lineWidth=isHovered?4:2.5;
          ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(-r*.83,-r*.84,r*1.66,r*1.68);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
          // A separate pattern and colour identify each parcel even without colour vision.
          ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(-r*.78,-r*.79,r*1.56,r*1.58);ctx.clip();
          ctx.strokeStyle=body.primaryColor;ctx.fillStyle=body.primaryColor;ctx.lineWidth=2;
          const pattern = ['micro_hole','yellow_sun'].includes(body.archetype) ? 0 : ['neutron_star','nebula_bubble'].includes(body.archetype) ? 1 : body.archetype ? 2 : (body.keyIndex-1)%3;
          for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++) {
            if(pattern===0){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-r,r*i*.45-r);ctx.lineTo(r,r*i*.45+r);ctx.stroke();}
            else if(pattern===1){for(let j=-2;j<=2;j++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(i*r*.38,j*r*.38,r*.065,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}}
            else {ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i*r*.38,-r);ctx.lineTo(i*r*.38,r);ctx.moveTo(-r,i*r*.38);ctx.lineTo(r,i*r*.38);ctx.stroke();}
          }
          ctx.restore();
          // Crossed packing twine and a large unambiguous identifying tag.
          ctx.strokeStyle='#9b7551';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-r*.84);ctx.lineTo(0,r*.84);ctx.moveTo(-r*.83,0);ctx.lineTo(r*.83,0);ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle='#fff9e9';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,r*.45,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle='#473c31';ctx.font='bold '+Math.round(r*.65)+'px serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText(body.symbol,0,1);
          ctx.restore();
        }

        function drawAsteroid(ctx, x, y, time, scaleFactor) {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(x, y);
          const sf = scaleFactor || 1;
          const r = 16 * sf;
          // Shaded grey rocky sphere with craters (no text label)
          const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-4 * sf, -4 * sf, 2 * sf, 0, 0, r);
          grad.addColorStop(0, '#cbd5e1');
          grad.addColorStop(0.6, '#64748b');
          grad.addColorStop(1, '#334155');
          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          ctx.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Craters
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(-4 * sf, -2 * sf, 3.5 * sf, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.arc(5 * sf, 4 * sf, 4 * sf, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.arc(-2 * sf, 7 * sf, 2.5 * sf, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Render Scale Beam with Centered Bounding Span & Adaptive Scale Factor (Prevents Overlap)
        function drawScale(
          ctx,
          scale,
          slotCx,
          slotCy,
          baseBeamHalf,
          bodiesById,
          time,
          recordTargets,
          scaleIndex,
          scaleFactor
        ) {
          const sf = scaleFactor || 1;
          const angle = scale.currentAngle;
          const cosA = Math.cos(angle);
          const sinA = Math.sin(angle);

          // Normalize arm length if asymmetric (1d vs 2d) so total width never overflows slot
          const totalDist = scale.leftDistance + scale.rightDistance;
          const armNorm = totalDist > 2.2 ? 2.1 / totalDist : 1.0;
          const leftArmLen = baseBeamHalf * scale.leftDistance * armNorm;
          const rightArmLen = baseBeamHalf * scale.rightDistance * armNorm;

          // Shift fulcrum horizontally so the midpoint between left & right pans is centered at slotCx
          const cx = slotCx - (rightArmLen - leftArmLen) * 0.5 * cosA;
          const cy = slotCy;

          const leftPivotX = cx - cosA * leftArmLen;
          const leftPivotY = cy - sinA * leftArmLen;
          const rightPivotX = cx + cosA * rightArmLen;
          const rightPivotY = cy + sinA * rightArmLen;

          ctx.save();

          // Degree arc & pedestal
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(cx, cy, 38 * sf, Math.PI * 0.15, Math.PI * 0.85);
          ctx.stroke();

          const pillarH = Math.min(82, canvasHeight * 0.11) * sf;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 3 * sf;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
          ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + pillarH);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2 * sf;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(cx - 26 * sf, cy + pillarH);
          ctx.lineTo(cx + 26 * sf, cy + pillarH);
          ctx.stroke();

          // Balance Beam
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
          ctx.lineWidth = 4 * sf;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(leftPivotX, leftPivotY);
          ctx.lineTo(rightPivotX, rightPivotY);
          ctx.stroke();

          // Lever Arm Distance Tick Marks & Visual Notches (arm 不一样: 1× vs 2×)
          if (scale.type === 'lever_asymmetric') {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.font = '700 ' + Math.max(9, Math.round(11 * sf)) + 'px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';

            const leftDistLabel = scale.leftDistance > 1.2 ? '2× ARM' : '1×';
            const rightDistLabel = scale.rightDistance > 1.2 ? '2× ARM' : '1×';

            ctx.fillText(leftDistLabel, (cx + leftPivotX) / 2, (cy + leftPivotY) / 2 - 10 * sf);
            ctx.fillText(rightDistLabel, (cx + rightPivotX) / 2, (cy + rightPivotY) / 2 - 10 * sf);

            // Draw a distinct yellow notch tick mark at the 1x halfway mark on the 2x arm
            const longPivotX = scale.leftDistance > 1.2 ? leftPivotX : rightPivotX;
            const longPivotY = scale.leftDistance > 1.2 ? leftPivotY : rightPivotY;
            const notchX = (cx + longPivotX) / 2;
            const notchY = (cy + longPivotY) / 2;

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#fbbf24';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2 * sf;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(notchX, notchY - 7 * sf);
            ctx.lineTo(notchX, notchY + 7 * sf);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.restore();
          }

          // Central Fulcrum Node
          ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(cx, cy, 8 * sf, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.stroke();

          // Pans
          const panDrop = 74 * sf;
          const pans = [
            {
              x: leftPivotX,
              y: leftPivotY + panDrop,
              pivotY: leftPivotY,
              items: scale.leftItems,
              isHeavier: scale.leftTorque > scale.rightTorque,
            },
            {
              x: rightPivotX,
              y: rightPivotY + panDrop,
              pivotY: rightPivotY,
              items: scale.rightItems,
              isHeavier: scale.rightTorque > scale.leftTorque,
            },
          ];

          pans.forEach((pan) => {
            const count = pan.items.length;
            const panWidth = (count > 1 ? 142 : 84) * sf;

            ctx.strokeStyle = pan.isHeavier
              ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.42)'
              : 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(pan.x, pan.pivotY + 5);
            ctx.lineTo(pan.x, pan.y);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);

            if (pan.isHeavier) {
              ctx.save();
              ctx.scale(1, 0.32);
              ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.32)';
              ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
              const rippleR = (24 + ((time * 22) % 20)) * sf;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(pan.x, (pan.y + 10 * sf) / 0.32, rippleR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.restore();
            }

            pan.items.forEach((item, idx) => {
              const itemScale = (count > 1 ? 0.72 : 1) * sf;
              const offsetX = count === 1 ? 0 : (idx - (count - 1) / 2) * 70 * sf;
              const ix = pan.x + offsetX;

              if (item.type === 'asteroid') {
                const iy = pan.y - 20 * sf;
                drawAsteroid(ctx, ix, iy, time, itemScale);
              } else {
                const body = bodiesById[item.bodyId || item.id];
                if (!body) return;
                const drawnR = body.visualRadius * itemScale;
                const iy = pan.y - drawnR - 10 * sf;

                let collapseFactor = itemScale;
                if (collapseAnim && collapseAnim.bodyId === body.id) {
                  collapseFactor = itemScale * Math.max(0.05, 1 - collapseAnim.progress * 1.4);
                }

                const isHovered = hoveredBodyId === body.id;
                drawMysteryParcel(
                  ctx,
                  body,
                  ix,
                  iy,
                  time,
                  isHovered,
                  collapseFactor
                );

                if (recordTargets) {
                  renderedBodyTargets.push({
                    bodyId: body.id,
                    x: ix,
                    y: iy,
                    hitRadius: Math.max(44, drawnR + 22),
                  });
                }
              }
            });

            // Cradle dish
            ctx.strokeStyle = pan.isHeavier ? '#38bdf8' : '#64748b';
            ctx.lineWidth = pan.isHeavier ? 3 : 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(pan.x - panWidth * 0.55, pan.y - 6 * sf);
            ctx.lineTo(pan.x - panWidth * 0.45, pan.y);
            ctx.lineTo(pan.x + panWidth * 0.45, pan.y);
            ctx.lineTo(pan.x + panWidth * 0.55, pan.y - 6 * sf);
            ctx.stroke();
          });

          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Title Showcase demo scale
        const titleDemoBodies = {
          alpha: {
            id: 'alpha',
            label: 'VOID BLACK HOLE',
            symbol: 'α',
            keyIndex: 1,
            archetype: 'micro_hole',
            densityDesc: 'Sealed mystery parcel',
            visualRadius: 24,
            primaryColor: '#a855f7',
            secondaryColor: '#e879f9',
            mass: 140,
          },
          beta: {
            id: 'beta',
            label: 'RINGED SATURN',
            symbol: 'β',
            keyIndex: 2,
            archetype: 'gas_giant',
            densityDesc: 'Sealed mystery parcel',
            visualRadius: 42,
            primaryColor: '#f59e0b',
            secondaryColor: '#dc2626',
            mass: 30,
          },
        };
        const titleDemoScale = {
          id: 'title-scale',
          type: 'simple',
          leftItems: [{ type: 'body', id: 'beta', bodyId: 'beta', mass: 30 }],
          rightItems: [{ type: 'body', id: 'alpha', bodyId: 'alpha', mass: 140 }],
          leftDistance: 1.0,
          rightDistance: 1.0,
          leftTorque: 30,
          rightTorque: 140,
          targetAngle: 0.24,
          currentAngle: 0.24,
          angularVel: 0,
        };

        // Main 60 FPS Loop with Damped Spring Tilting Physics
        let lastFrameTime = performance.now();

        function tick(now) {
          const rawDt = (now - lastFrameTime) / 1000;
          lastFrameTime = now;
          const dt = Math.min(Math.max(rawDt, 0.001), 0.05);
          const timeSec = now / 1000;

          cameraTrauma = Math.max(0, cameraTrauma - dt * 2.2);
          redFlashAlpha = Math.max(0, redFlashAlpha - dt * 1.8);
          if (gameState === 'playing' && !window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('space-scale')) {
            globalTimeSec = Math.max(0, globalTimeSec - dt);
            syncHudDOM();
            if (globalTimeSec <= 0) triggerGameOver();
          }

          if (gameState === 'playing') {
            if (hitstopTimer > 0) {
              hitstopTimer = Math.max(0, hitstopTimer - dt);
            } else if (collapseAnim) {
              collapseAnim.progress += dt / collapseAnim.duration;
              if (collapseAnim.progress >= 1) {
                collapseAnim = null;
                loadWave(wave + 1);
              }
            } else {

              if (!Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isActive?.('space-scale'))) waveElapsedSec += dt;
              syncHudDOM();

            }

            // Damped Spring Harmonic Tilting on spawn (settles in ~0.4s)
            if (currentPuzzle) {
              for (let i = 0; i < currentPuzzle.scales.length; i++) {
                const s = currentPuzzle.scales[i];
                const stiffness = 28;
                const damping = 9.2;
                const accel = (s.targetAngle - s.currentAngle) * stiffness - s.angularVel * damping;
                s.angularVel += accel * dt;
                s.currentAngle += s.angularVel * dt;
              }
            }
          }

          // Particles
          for (let i = 0; i < shockwaves.length; i++) {
            const sw = shockwaves[i];
            if (sw.active) {
              sw.life += dt;
              if (sw.life >= sw.maxLife) {
                sw.active = false;
              } else {
                const p = sw.life / sw.maxLife;
                sw.radius = 8 + (sw.maxRadius - 8) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3));
                sw.alpha = 1 - p;
              }
            }
          }

          for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
            const p = particles[i];
            if (p.active) {
              p.life += dt;
              if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
                p.active = false;
              } else {
                p.x += p.vx * dt;
                p.y += p.vy * dt;
                p.vx *= 0.95;
                p.vy *= 0.95;
                p.alpha = 1 - p.life / p.maxLife;
              }
            }
          }

          // Render
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#2d4943';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);

          if (cameraTrauma > 0.001) {
            const shake = cameraTrauma * cameraTrauma * 20;
            const sx = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * shake;
            const sy = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * shake;
            ctx.translate(sx, sy);
          }

          ctx.fillStyle='rgba(194,160,108,.12)';ctx.fillRect(0,canvasHeight-26,canvasWidth,26);
          ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(206,177,126,.18)';ctx.lineWidth=8;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(9,140);ctx.lineTo(9,canvasHeight);ctx.moveTo(canvasWidth-9,140);ctx.lineTo(canvasWidth-9,canvasHeight);ctx.stroke();
          if (gameState !== 'title' && window.ToenowAnimals) window.ToenowAnimals.drawAnimal(ctx,'fox',canvasWidth*.5,canvasHeight-40,62);
          // Fireflies above the weighhouse
          for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
            const st = stars[i];
            const sy = ((st.y + timeSec * st.speed) % 1) * canvasHeight;
            const sx = st.x * canvasWidth;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(226, 232, 240, ' + st.alpha.toFixed(2) + ')';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx, sy, st.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
          }

          if (gameState === 'title') {
            // Title background demo scale hidden as requested
          } else if (currentPuzzle) {
            renderedBodyTargets = [];
            const bodiesById = {};
            for (let i = 0; i < currentPuzzle.bodies.length; i++) {
              const b = currentPuzzle.bodies[i];
              bodiesById[b.id] = b;
            }

            const scaleCount = currentPuzzle.scales.length;

            function getScaleLayout(count, W, H) {
              const isMobile = W < 768;
              const positions = [];
              let baseBeam = 0;
              let scaleFactor = 1.0;

              if (count === 1) {
                baseBeam = Math.min(190, W * (isMobile ? 0.28 : 0.24));
                scaleFactor = isMobile ? 0.92 : 1.0;
                positions.push({ x: W * 0.5, y: H * 0.52 });
              } else if (count === 2) {
                if (isMobile) {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(92, W * 0.22);
                  scaleFactor = 0.74;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.5, y: H * 0.36 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.5, y: H * 0.70 });
                } else {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(125, W * 0.13);
                  scaleFactor = 0.84;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.27, y: H * 0.52 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.73, y: H * 0.52 });
                }
              } else if (count === 3) {
                if (isMobile) {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(80, W * 0.19);
                  scaleFactor = 0.60;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.5, y: H * 0.30 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.5, y: H * 0.53 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.5, y: H * 0.76 });
                } else {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(98, W * 0.10);
                  scaleFactor = 0.72;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.22, y: H * 0.40 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.50, y: H * 0.68 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.78, y: H * 0.40 });
                }
              } else if (count === 4) {
                if (isMobile) {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(48, W * 0.12);
                  scaleFactor = 0.46;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.27, y: H * 0.37 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.73, y: H * 0.37 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.27, y: H * 0.71 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.73, y: H * 0.71 });
                } else {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(90, W * 0.095);
                  scaleFactor = 0.66;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.28, y: H * 0.38 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.72, y: H * 0.38 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.28, y: H * 0.72 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.72, y: H * 0.72 });
                }
              } else if (count === 5) {
                if (isMobile) {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(44, W * 0.11);
                  scaleFactor = 0.42;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.27, y: H * 0.28 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.73, y: H * 0.28 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.50, y: H * 0.52 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.27, y: H * 0.76 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.73, y: H * 0.76 });
                } else {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(80, W * 0.08);
                  scaleFactor = 0.60;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.20, y: H * 0.38 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.50, y: H * 0.38 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.80, y: H * 0.38 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.35, y: H * 0.72 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.65, y: H * 0.72 });
                }
              } else {
                // 6 scales
                if (isMobile) {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(42, W * 0.105);
                  scaleFactor = 0.40;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.27, y: H * 0.28 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.73, y: H * 0.28 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.27, y: H * 0.52 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.73, y: H * 0.52 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.27, y: H * 0.76 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.73, y: H * 0.76 });
                } else {
                  baseBeam = Math.min(78, W * 0.078);
                  scaleFactor = 0.56;
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.20, y: H * 0.38 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.50, y: H * 0.38 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.80, y: H * 0.38 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.20, y: H * 0.72 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.50, y: H * 0.72 });
                  positions.push({ x: W * 0.80, y: H * 0.72 });
                }
              }

              return { positions, baseBeam, scaleFactor };
            }

            const layout = getScaleLayout(scaleCount, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
            for (let i = 0; i < scaleCount; i++) {
              const pos = layout.positions[i] || { x: canvasWidth * 0.5, y: canvasHeight * 0.5 };
              drawScale(
                ctx,
                currentPuzzle.scales[i],
                pos.x,
                pos.y,
                layout.baseBeam,
                bodiesById,
                timeSec,
                true,
                i,
                layout.scaleFactor
              );
            }

            // Cross-scale linkage arcs
            if (renderedBodyTargets.length > 2) {
              currentPuzzle.bodies.forEach((b) => {
                const matches = renderedBodyTargets.filter((t) => t.bodyId === b.id);
                if (matches.length >= 2) {
                  const isHov = hoveredBodyId === b.id;
                  ctx.save();
                  ctx.strokeStyle = isHov
                    ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.75)'
                    : 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22)';
                  ctx.lineWidth = isHov ? 2 : 1.2;
                  ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
                  ctx.beginPath();
                  for (let m = 0; m < matches.length - 1; m++) {
                    const p1 = matches[m];
                    const p2 = matches[m + 1];
                    const midX = (p1.x + p2.x) * 0.5;
                    const midY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y) - 40;
                    ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
                    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX, midY, p2.x, p2.y);
                  }
                  ctx.stroke();
                  ctx.restore();
                }
              });
            }
          }

          // Shockwaves
          for (let i = 0; i < shockwaves.length; i++) {
            const sw = shockwaves[i];
            if (sw.active) {
              ctx.save();
              ctx.strokeStyle = sw.color;
              ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, sw.alpha);
              ctx.lineWidth = 4 * sw.alpha + 1;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(sw.x, sw.y, sw.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.restore();
            }
          }

          // Burst particles
          for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
            const p = particles[i];
            if (p.active) {
              ctx.save();
              ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
              ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.alpha);
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.fill();
              ctx.restore();
            }
          }

          // Red screen damage flash
          if (redFlashAlpha > 0.01) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, ' + (redFlashAlpha * 0.38).toFixed(3) + ')';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
          }

          ctx.restore();

          if (IS_HEADLESS) {
            setTimeout(() => requestAnimationFrame(tick), 60);
          } else {
            requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          }
        }

        window.ToenowTutorials?.register?.('space-scale', {
          start() { startNewGame(1, true); },
          stop() { isPracticeMode = false; collapseAnim = null; setGameState('title'); },
          getGuide() {
            const target = renderedBodyTargets.find(t => t.bodyId === currentPuzzle?.targetBodyId);
            const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            const directive = currentPuzzle?.directive === 'min' ? 'lighter' : 'heavier';
            return { prompt: 'The lower side is heavier. Tap the ' + directive + ' parcel.', rect: target ? { x: bounds.left + target.x - target.hitRadius, y: bounds.top + target.y - target.hitRadius, width: target.hitRadius * 2, height: target.hitRadius * 2 } : null, waiting: !target, done: Boolean(window.ToenowTutorials?.isComplete?.('space-scale')) };
          }
        });

        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
